title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
Description BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own Email & Retention Design

- Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
- Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
- Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms
Web Creative & CRO Support

- Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
- Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste
- Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs
Social & Ad Creative

- Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
- Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
- Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed
Process & Quality

- Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
- Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
- Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients
- Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines
Who You Are Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

- An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself
- Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
- Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
- A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
- Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
- AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
- Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.
What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days:

- You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
- You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
- You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
- You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
- Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

Must-Have:

- 2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
- A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results
- Advanced proficiency in Figma
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
- Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
- Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
- Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
- Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
- Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team
Strong Differentiators:

- Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
- Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
- Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
- Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
- Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
- Agency background preferred

This role is fully remote.

Time Commitment and Availability

- Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
- Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST
Compensation

$20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

title: Technical Customer Support
description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

- Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.

- Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.

- Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

- Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.

- Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.

- Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

- Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.

- Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.

- Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

- Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.

- Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.

- Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

- Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.

- Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

- You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.

- You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.

- You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.

- You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.

- Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.

- You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.

- You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.

- You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.

- Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.

- Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

- Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.

- Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.

- Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.

- Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.

- An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

- Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.

- Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.

- Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.

- The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.

- The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

- Contract type: full-time or part-time

- Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).

- Start date: negotiable

title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
description:
Location : 100% remote (Ohio residency required) 

Classification : Full-time, exempt
Reports to : School Leader 

Pay Range : $40.00 - $48.00 per hour 

Welcome to Miaplaza! 

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! 

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary 

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions. 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 

Instructional Staff Management 

- Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting. 

- Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers. 

- Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback. 

- Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback. 

- Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals. 

- Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences. 

- Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations. 

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity 

- Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed. 

- Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes. 

- Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law. 

- Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together. 

- Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns. 

- Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track. 

- Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

- Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas. 

Academic Data & Testing Coordination 

- Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. 

- Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions. 

- Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing. 

- Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. 

- Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families. 

Professional Development 

- Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data. 

- Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team. 

- Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities. 

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration 

- Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues. 

- Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations. 

- Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments. 

- Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices. 

- Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For 

- Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers 

- Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate 

- A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals 

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny 

- A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability 

- Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions 

- Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities 

- Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment 

- Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback 

THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred 

- Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements 

- At least 3 years of teaching experience 

- At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal 

- Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online 

- Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews 

- Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems 

The Ideal Candidate Brings: 

- Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data 

- Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school 

Compensation & Benefits 

- The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. An Academic Dean at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio works an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $83,000 - $99,800. 

- Miaplazaâs compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity. 

- Compensation is evaluated twice per year, based on performance. 

- Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, inclusive of specialty care options like fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, FSA, HSA, and more. 

- All employees are eligible for a retirement plan with employer match. 

- PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour per every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 200hours per year or 25 eight-hour days on average. 

- Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.

title: Product Engineering Lead
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 

At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Innovate with Tether 

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. 

But thatâs just the beginning: 

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. 

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. 

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 

Why Join Us? 

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. 

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself. 

Responsibilities 

- Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference. 

- Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them. 

- Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it. 

Mandatory: 

- Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps. 

- Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one. 

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. 

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. 

Preferred: 

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source . 

Important information for candidates 
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: 

- Apply only through our official channels. Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/ 

- Verify the recruiterâs identity. Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. 

- Be cautious of unusual communication methods. Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. 

- Double-check email addresses. Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @ tether.to orÂ @ tether.io

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do: - Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
- Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
- Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
- Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
- Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
- Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
- Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
- Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
- Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 

What you'll bring: - Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
- Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
- Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
- The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
- The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
- Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
- Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
- Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
- Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
- An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

- A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
- A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
- Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
- A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
- Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie? Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

- We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
- We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
- We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
- We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â 
Application process: If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â 

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

description:
Leverage Live Local prepares and manages Florida Live Local Act property tax exemptions for multifamily owners. We represent more than 90 properties and about 30,000 units. Demand is not our constraint. Operations is. This seat owns the operating system that lets us grow without breaking.

- The annual recertification and compliance cadence

title: Director Payment Integrity
description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity 

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties: 

- Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management

- Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes

- Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements

- Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff

- Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA

- Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities

- Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights

- Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise

- Interact directly with customers as needed

- Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others

- Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs

- Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement: 

- B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation

- 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment

- Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements

- Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do 

- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for 

- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit 

- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting 

- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

description:

Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube .

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. 

What You Will Own 

- Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling. 

- Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure. 

- Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it. 

- Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing. 

- Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product. 

- The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement. 

- Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data. 

What We Are Looking For 

- 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function. 

- A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench. 

- Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body. 

- Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization). 

- Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance. 

Strongly preferred 

- Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management. 

- Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription. 

- Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus. 

Why Now 

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it. 

Why work at Delinea? 

- We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

- We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

- What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success: 

- Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

- Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

- Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

- Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

- Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

- Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

title: Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy 

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role 

The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

- Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

- Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

- Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

- Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

- Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

- You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

- Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

- Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

- Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

- People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

- Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

Nice to have 

- Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

- Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

- Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

- Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

- Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

- A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.

Why work with Us? 

- Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

- Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

- Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

- Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

- Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

- Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

- Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

- Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

- Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

- Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

- You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

- You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

- You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

- You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

- You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

- You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path: 

- Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

- Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

- 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives 

📣 Generate pipeline 

- Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

- Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

- Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities 

- Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

- Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION 

- Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

- Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

- Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT 

As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints.

- Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs.

- Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems.

- Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads.

- Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines.

WHO YOU ARE 

- A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems

- Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies

- Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.

- Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus.

- Understanding of quasi optical propagation of millimeter waves; ray tracing and where it breaks down

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

As an NPI Engineer, you will be the central figure industrializing our developments together with our engineering team, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. 

Beyond traditional hardware ramp-up, this role is critical in building the "digital thread" of our serial production. You will be responsible for ensuring that as we scale quantities, our data remains structured, traceable, and ready for deep analytical insight. 

What is your Day to Day Mission: 

- Electrical System Architecture, Design, and Validation of Electric Powertrains

- Define systems and component requirements in collaboration with the project management team

- Conducting full PCBA development cycle: Design, Coordinating Manufacturing Process, Bring up, Verification, and Validation of PCBs

- Collaboration with our firmware engineering team across all processes

- Schematic design for BMS and charger updates, including bug fixes

- Schematic design for a combined testing platform charger-battery

- Design of battery simulation testbench

- Final PCB implementation with supervision of BMS and charger

- Defining subsystem-level test plans

- Following test plans

What you bring to the team: 

- Ability to work from our offices in Munich, Germany

- Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related fields

- At least three years of experience in the field

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills

- Experience in PCB design is a must

- Hands-on experience in an electronic lab environment is a must

- Understanding of power electronics systems

- Understanding of embedded firmware infrastructure

- Experience with compliance testing and EMC

- A structured approach to work and project management experience

- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal

- German language skills are welcome

Your Benefits: 

- Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

- Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

- Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

- Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

- Mobility Benefit: With our mobility budget, we pay your “Germany Ticket” for work or personal use monthly. 

- Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. 

- Language Courses: German isn’t your mother tongue? We sponsor German courses for you to quickly learn and integrate even more.

title: Senior Buchhalter (m/w/x)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Finanzbereichs suchen wir Dich als erfahrenen Senior Buchhalter (m/w/d) , der nicht nur fachlich sicher im Rechnungswesen ist, sondern auch mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mitarbeitet. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung in der operativen Buchhaltung und bringst Dein Know-how in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Abläufen ein. Perspektivisch ist vorgesehen, dass Du im nächsten Schritt die fachliche Verantwortung für unser dreiköpfiges Team im Rechnungswesen übernimmst und damit eine wichtige Schlüsselrolle in unserem Finanzbereich einnimmst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung nach HGB, insbesondere in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung

- Mitarbeit bei der termingerechten Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB

- Durchführung von Kontenabstimmungen sowie Klärung und Buchung von Sachverhalten im Hauptbuch

- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Auswertungen, Reports und betriebswirtschaftlichen Analysen für die Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche

- Mitwirkung bei der Liquiditätsplanung sowie Unterstützung im Zahlungsverkehr und Mahnwesen

- Sicherstellung einer ordnungsgemäßen Buchführung unter Einhaltung gesetzlicher, steuerlicher und interner Vorgaben

- Ansprechpartner für buchhalterische Fragestellungen innerhalb des Unternehmens sowie für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und externe Dienstleister

- Mitwirkung bei steuerlich relevanten Themen, insbesondere im Bereich Umsatzsteuer, in Abstimmung mit externen Beratern

- Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von buchhalterischen Prozessen, Richtlinien und internen Kontrollen

- Mitarbeit an Projekten im Finanzbereich, z. B. bei der Digitalisierung, ERP-Weiterentwicklung oder der Optimierung von Reporting-Strukturen

- Je nach Teamstruktur fachliche Unterstützung und Anleitung von Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Rechnungswesen

Fachliche Anforderungen: 

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) oder abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen/Finanzen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, idealerweise in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse im HGB sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

- Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung

- Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise SAP R/3, sowie sehr gute MS-Excel-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit BI-Tools von Vorteil

- Gute Kenntnisse in umsatzsteuerlichen Fragestellungen; weitere steuerliche Kenntnisse von Vorteil

- Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit

- Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude an der operativen Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft

- Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Affinität zu Zahlen, Prozessen und Systemen

- Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. 

We are looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success. 

The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content. 

SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces. 

- Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe. 

- Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility. 

- Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations. 

- Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability. 

- Lead sys tem-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration 

- Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance. 

- Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

- M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field. 

- 5+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms. 

- Very strong background in communication theory. 

- Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation). 

- Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS). 

- Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams. 

- Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews. 

- Fluent in English (German language skills a plus). 

- Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance. 

WHAT WE OFFER 

- The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team.

- High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.

- Competitive compensation and benefits package.

- A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.

CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization. 

Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Integration & Data Fluent.

title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
description:

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core. 

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market. 

Find out more about us, the team and our values here. 

What you will work on 

Your mission 

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send. 

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. - Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

- Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

- Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.
