Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction 

At XYZ Reality , we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role 

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing 

- Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

- Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

- Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

- Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

- Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

- Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

- Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

- Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

- Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

- Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

- Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

- Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

- Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

- Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

- Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

- Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For 

- 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

- MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

- Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

- Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

- Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

- Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

- Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

- Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

- Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

- Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

- Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

- A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On 

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:

- 3D construction scene understanding

- Construction semantic segmentation

- Automated BIM understanding and object correspondence

- Spatial reasoning across wearable sensor data

- Embedded AI deployment

- Foundation models for construction understanding

- Perception for wearable AR

Why Join Us

- 🚀 Work at the intersection of Spatial AI, 3D Computer Vision, AR and real-world engineering

- 🥽 Develop AI that ultimately runs through physical, wearable technology – not just software on a screen

title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés : 

- 
950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 

- 
8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. 

- 
Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 

- 
15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... 

- 
+5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. 

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. 

▪️ À propos du poste 

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise. 

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous. 

Les missions : 

- 
Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine). 

- 
Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS). 

- 
Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée. 

- 
Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu. 

- 
Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle. 

- 
Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord. 

- 
Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act). 

- 
S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts. 

- 
Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR. 

▪️ Le profil idéal 

- 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA 

- Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...) 

- Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A) 

- Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte 

- Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles 

- Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu 

- Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA 

Un plus 

- Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…) 

- Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD 

- Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini), 

- Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions 

- Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent 

- Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks 

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais 

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. 

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

- Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. 

- Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). 

- Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. 

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

- Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. 

- Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians. 

- Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux 

- Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

title: Strategic Partner Account Manager DACH
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. 

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. 

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc). Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.

- 
Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets.

- 
Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity.

- 
Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

Partner Relationship Management: 

- Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities.

- 
Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement: 

- 
Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets.

- 
Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral.

- 
Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners.

- 
Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution.

Forecasting & Reporting: 

- 
Accurately forecast partner sales and contribute to overall company revenue projections.

- 
Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management.

Program Development & Optimization: 

- 
Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the channel partner program, including policies, incentives, and marketing initiatives.

- 
Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements.

- 
Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in channel management

Qualifications: 

- Confident Communicator. Languages: Native German language, English fluent. 

- 
You have at least 2-3 years of experience, ideally in partnership development, in a competitive, data-driven environment. 

- 
You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and an interest in technology

- 
Analytical and strategic thinking abilities, KPI driven approach.

- 
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
description:

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

✍️ What you'll do

- 
Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy , identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

- 
Build senior relationships with leading brands , engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

- 
Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. - 
Develop strategic commercial partnerships , from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

-

10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

- 
A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

- 
Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

- 
Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

Pour être au cœur de l’exploitation de clients de renommée mondiale, en redéfinissant l’expérience utilisateur, grâce à une technologie de rupture.

Nous sommes une équipe riche de sa diversité, axée sur le mérite — et répartie dans six bureaux dans le monde. Le talent et l'impact sont ce qui compte avant tout chez vivenu.

Sifted classe vivenu parmi les scale-ups à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous sommes nourris par la volonté d’apprendre au quotidien et de nous améliorer continuement. 

Développer notre position de leaders et contribuer directement à la transformation de notre industrie 

Travaillez aux côtés de visionnaires — des fondateurs de Forbes 30 Under 30, aux lauréats du prix Executive of the Year. Chez vivenu, vous contribuerez à établir les nouvelles normes de l'industrie de la billetterie.

Nous nous engageons à créer un cadre de travail qui offre à chaque collaborateur la possibilité de contribuer au succès de tous et de s'épanouir.

title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. 

About the Job 

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging .

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role .

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios , support atypical and beta deployments , and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do 

- 
Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

- 
Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

- 
Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

- 
Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

- 
Apply hotfixes when appropriate

- 
Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

- 
Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

- 
Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

- 
Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact

What we're looking for 

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

- 
2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

- 
Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

- 
C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

- 
Proficiency in Linux systems

- 
Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

- 
Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

- 
Driver’s license B category

Beneficial 

- 
Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

- 
Field testing experience

- 
Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

- 
Experience in motion planning or control

- 
Experience in robotic competitions

Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions.

This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

title: Team Lead - Invoices
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role 

Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product.

This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important:

- Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale.

- Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised.

- Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build.

As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring.

This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result.

You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned.

What you'll do 

Lead and grow the team 

- Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership.

- Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows.

- Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early.

Hire 

- Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition.

- Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy.

Own the roadmap and priorities 

- Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.

- Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward.

- Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization.

Deliver for strategic enterprise customers 

- Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness.

- Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates.

- Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.

What you'll bring 

- You have led an engineering team of 8+ people for at least two years, ideally in B2B SaaS, and you have grown a team through hiring rather than only inheriting one.

- You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers.

- You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process.

- You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders.

- You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship.

- You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads.

- You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard.

- You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region.

What you'll get 

- A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery.

- Impact you can measure. Automation rates and go-lives on our largest accounts are directly visible to customers and to the business.

- A strong team. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place.

- A smooth handover. The current team lead moves into a new role in engineering leadership and stays available to support your start.

- Room to grow. As a fast-growing, global AI company, BLP keeps creating new leadership opportunities.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. 

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. 

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists 

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own 

- Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

- The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

- The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

- Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

- The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

- The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work 

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year 

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for 

- You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

- You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

- You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

- You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

- You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

- You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

- You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

- English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out 

- You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

- You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

- You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

- You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team 

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts 

- Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

- Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

- Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

- Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

- Pensum: 100%

- Start: As soon as possible

- Language: English; German a plus

- Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply 

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

Was du mitbringst 

- Einen sehr guten akademischen Leistungsausweis, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Data Science oder Ingenieurwissenschaften. Wissbegierde, Kreativität und nachweisbare Leistungen sind uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Studienrichtung.

Verantwortung und Raum für Initiative.

Die Möglichkeit, mit Urban Connect zu wachsen.

At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re looking for an Engineer II to join our Platform squad working on one of Hudl’s most innovative products: next-generation, fully automated sports cameras . These autonomous cameras use edge AI to automatically track the action and upload to the cloud, giving our customers seamless access to vital, real-time video and insights.

The Platform squad builds the foundation our hardware teams rely on - the build systems, tooling, update pipeline and security processes that take our cameras from development through manufacturing and into the field. As we bring up our next-generation hardware platform, you’ll help shape how it’s built, tested, shipped and kept secure.

As an Engineer II, you’ll:

- Keep our infrastructure running. You’ll maintain our CI/CD infrastructure, including the regression testing that runs in manufacturing.

- Ship updates to the field. You’ll roll out software updates to our customers’ cameras safely and predictably.

- Enable manufacturing. You’ll provide the tooling our contract manufacturers use to flash, provision and test devices on the production line.

- Own the problem. You’ll work in an autonomous squad that has the freedom and expertise to deliver the best solution.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

- Yocto experience. You’ve worked with Yocto and are comfortable building and customizing images.

Nice-to-Haves

- Embedded platform experience. You’ve worked with SoC vendor BSPs, flashing tools or secure boot on platforms.

- Low-level development. You’re comfortable reading and debugging C/C++ code, from user space down to kernel drivers.

- Security vulnerability management. You have experience identifying, triaging and resolving security vulnerabilities in embedded Linux systems.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

- Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

- Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

- User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

- Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

- Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

- Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

- Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

- Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.

About the Role 

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.

What you'll be doing 

- Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there

- Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them

- Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no

- Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation

- Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production

- Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

What you'll need 

- You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it

- Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it

- A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed

- Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results

- You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

Nice to have 

- Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger

- Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech

- Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets

- Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

Our stack 

Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.

None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.

How we hire 

Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:

- Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.

- Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.

- Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.

- Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.

- Meet the Founder. 

You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.

We offer 

- Competitive compensation . We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants

- Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days

- Pension. 6% employer contribution

- Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over

- Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching

- Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

About Insify 

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

- Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize based on ROI, conversion, and pipeline metrics.

- Build quarterly business reviews and performance updates for leadership.

- Share best practices across EMEA and contribute to scalable regional programs.

- Experience working with indirect routes to market including VARs, distributors, alliances, and service providers

- Strong commercial acumen and ability to prioritise investment by market opportunity

- Comfortable operating in matrixed, fast-growth environments

- Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills

- Experience in using technologies such as SDFC, Asana, Reachdesk, G-Suite, Zoom Info, ON24

Preferred Experience

description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for an Account Executive to cover the Belgium and Luxembourg markets . Enterprise Account Executives have a critical role and responsibility to deliver new client acquisition in zero-base accounts, while also ensuring successful relationships and revenue growth with existing customers. 

OneTrust is a fast-growing SaaS enterprise platform with a strong growth trajectory. We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals.

Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.
Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role: 

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production.

The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster.

What you’ll do: 

- Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services

- Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately

- Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform

- Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time

- Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality

- Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t

- Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage

What you’ll bring: 

- 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering

- Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them.

- Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality

- Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement

- Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool

- Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners

- A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs.

This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production.

People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers .

Benefits: 

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Lunch Provided in Office

- Team building events

- Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software? 

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi 

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Director, Business Development - EMEA
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Growth organization identifies, shapes, captures, and grows new opportunities for the company.

This role sits within the Connected Warfare Division . Connected Warfare builds the software and hardware substrate for global, multi-domain command and control (C2) — joint, time-sensitive, connected mesh ecosystems that link every robot, human, and sensor across every domain to close kill chains and enable mission autonomy. The division includes the Voyager team, which delivers ruggedised computing and communications platforms for the network edge. 

About the Job 

- This is a sales role. You are here to hunt and close new business for Connected Warfare across Europe and the Middle East. 

- Based in continental Europe, you'll report to the Head of Growth for Anduril's International Connected Warfare business. You carry initial responsibility for the region, with scope to expand as the business scales.

- European defence environments come with sovereign requirements, legacy architectures, and security constraints. You will know these pain points cold and demonstrate how Anduril integrates with — and supercharges — the systems customers already operate.

- The work is matrixed: you'll pull on programs, engineering, capture, software, finance, partners, and customers to win. The deliverable is unambiguous: pipeline, partners, and signed contracts. This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports. Your impact is measured in the business you build and the contracts you close

What You’ll Do

- Drive go-to-market. Stand up and execute the Connected Warfare growth strategy across Europe and the Middle East. Identify, qualify, shape, and close complex opportunities with Allied nations, navigating international procurement cycles and sovereign requirements to secure long-term programs of record.

- Generate and capture new business. Run a dual-track motion: hunt and close net-new customers across the region while partnering with delivery teams to scale and expand current contracts.

- Map customer requirements. Build a working understanding of regional defence requirements, security constraints, and legacy architectures. Show how Anduril's open architecture integrates with sovereign systems to solve real operational problems.

- Build and manage the regional channel. Identify, onboard, and manage strategic partners, resellers, system integrators, and European primes. Coordinate with Anduril's Global Defense team on teaming agreements that accelerate adoption.

- Run the internal matrix. Maintain close working relationships across business line and division leadership, growth, programs, engineering, and corporate functions to shape opportunities and unblock execution.

- Deliver the number. Hit financial performance targets and build the multi-year plan to back them up. Provide leadership with long-term growth and product strategy for Connected Warfare in region.

- Inform product. Translate region-specific mission profiles, sovereign cloud requirements, and degraded-network realities back into the product roadmap.

- Represent Anduril. Communicate technical and operational value to senior military officials, procurement officers, and partners — articulating how Lattice-enabled C2 closes kill chains in contested environments

Growth Activities

- Use Salesforce as the system of record — accounts, pricing, points of contact, expected close dates, and all customer activity

- Partner with Sales Engineering to refine customer solutions

- Perform live and static demonstrations on-site or via VTC

- Create and deliver client presentations and proposals tailored to specific customer needs

- Identify regional contract vehicles (e.g. NATO frameworks, national procurement programmes) and lead proposal development

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in defence, dual-use, or enterprise networking sales, with at least 5 years closing business with European government and military customers

- A proven hunter: documented record of identifying, qualifying, and closing complex deals with European Ministries of Defence (MoDs), NATO bodies, or coalition partners — opened the door, shaped the requirement, closed the contract

- Deep familiarity with European defence procurement cycles, budgeting, and sovereign security frameworks

- Ability to quickly master highly technical concepts (mesh networking, edge compute, C2, cloud architecture) and credibly brief senior military and technical leaders

- A builder with high agency: has stood up a regional pipeline, country, or business line from a standing start — not just managed an existing book. Owns outcomes, prioritizes ruthlessly, operates well in greenfield environments

- Operates effectively in a matrixed organization — partners well with BL leadership, engineering, capture, and corporate functions. Low ego, high collaboration

- Demonstrated experience building and managing a regional channel — resellers, system integrators, and prime partnerships

- Strong command of capture management or an equivalent enterprise sales pursuit methodology

- Strong cross-cultural communication and negotiation skills

- Native or fluent English; a second European language (Dutch, German, French) or Arabic is a plus

- Willingness to travel up to 50% across Europe and the Middle East

- Right to work in the EU; eligible to obtain and maintain EU and/or NATO-level security clearances

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior operational or industry experience in C4ISR, JADC2, or tactical communications — including service in an allied military, intelligence, or government digital/IT function

- Established network within European military headquarters, defence procurement agencies, and European defence primes

- Experience supporting export-controlled programs (US ITAR / EAR, UK Export Control, EU dual-use) and navigating sovereign data residency / cloud hosting regulations

- Experience standing up a new sales region for a defence-tech or enterprise networking company

Europe and the Middle East are rearming. The next decade of defence spend in this region will be measured in the billions, and the contracts being shaped right now will run for twenty years. We're hiring the person who's going to win our share of it.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden 

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

- Werk je in dagdienst

- Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

- Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

- Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

- Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

- Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

- Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

- Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

- Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

Jouw profiel 

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

- Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

- Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

- Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

- Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

- Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

- Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

- Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

Welkome extra kennis en ervaring: 

- Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

- Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

- Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

- Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

Over DSL-01 

In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Waarom deze rol? 

Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌ 

Solliciteer 

Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌ 

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com .

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. 

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience

About us 

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role 

As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers.

What you will do 

- Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses.

- Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition.

- Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer.

- Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition.

- Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface.

- Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery.

- Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer.

- Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool.

Your profile 

- MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field.

- ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation.

- Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux.

- Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ).

- Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware.

- Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks.

- Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet.

- Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

- Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus 

- Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition.

- Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering.

- High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development.

- Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data.

- Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment.

- Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team.

What we offer 

- Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

- A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product.

- Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.

- A competitive salary for the Dutch market.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As our organization continues to grow, attracting the best talent remains one of our highest priorities. To achieve this, it's essential to adapt by refining our recruitment strategies, upholding exceptional quality in our efforts, and embracing innovative recruitment methodologies. This is where our Talent Acquisition (TA) team plays a vital role.

In the role of Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a pivotal part in achieving the team's primary goal: attracting and hiring the right talent for Vinted while ensuring an outstanding candidate experience. Leveraging your expertise in recruitment, you will implement best hiring practices and collaborate with other team members on various projects. You’ll support either our Group & Marketplace business units, covering Community Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and People, or our Vinted Pay & VintedGo business units, covering AML/Compliance, Business & Commercial and Logistics, with your focus shifting based on business needs.

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organization's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-months fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs. 

In this position, you’ll 

- Collaborate with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and ensure a seamless interview process to attract the right talent

- Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers

- Build effective candidate talent pools through proactive sourcing, job boards, employee referrals, social media & employer branding campaigns etc

- Guide hiring managers and interviewers on effective interview techniques and candidate evaluation methods

- Track and report on key hiring metrics to ensure efficient recruitment processes, while providing a positive candidate and hiring manager experience

- Gain exposure to talent acquisition initiatives by contributing to process improvement projects 

- Stay informed about recruitment best practices and tools to continually improve the candidate experience

About you 

- Previous experience as a Sourcer, Recruiter or Talent Acquisition Specialist specifically 

- Proficiency in sourcing candidates using LinkedIn and other recruitment tools

- Strong skills in candidate engagement and relationship building

- Good understanding of assessment tools and interview evaluation techniques

- Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across teams and levels

- A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn and grow within the talent acquisition field

Work perks

- 25 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)

- Frequent team-building events

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per working day

- Company bike leasing scheme

- Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

- Work from Home allowance 

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

- NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity
