What we offer 

- Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

- Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

- Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

- Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

- Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

- Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

- Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

- Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

- Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

- Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

- Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons

- Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

- Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process 

- Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual 

- Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual

- Final Interview - 30 mins - IRL/Virtual

- Values Interview - 30mins IRL

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance.

- Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.

- Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.

- Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.

- Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.

- Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills 

- Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field

- Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)

- Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level

- Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on

- Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments

- EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have 

- Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it? 

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. 

About AIHR 

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. 

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. 

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. 

Why a designer now 

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market. 

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind. 

Role and Responsibilities 

As our Senior Product Designer , you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster. 

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set. 

Journeys and engagement 

- Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit. 

- Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky. 

- Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data. 

Growth surfaces 

- Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels. 

- Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from. 

Craft and UI ownership 

- You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence. 

- During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent. 

Design system and enablement 

- Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan. 

- Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with. 

How you work 

- You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision. 

- You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision. 

- You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign. 

On a typical week 

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. 

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience. 

On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves. 

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details. 

On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined. 

We offer 

- A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution; 

- Competitive, benchmarked compensation; 

- The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work; 

- Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals; 

- Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements 

- A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; 

- A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; 

- A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 

- 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here 

- Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice; 

- Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year; 

- Pension plan; 

- 5 Mental health days per year; 

- Access to OpenUp mental health platform; 

- Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read; 

- All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); 

- MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; 

- Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; 

- Free access to the office gym. 

Apply for the job 

Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer ? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate. 

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. 

Who you are 

You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if: 

- You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech. 

- You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you. 

- You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas . 

- You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion. 

- You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence. 

- You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard. 

- You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same. 

- You see feedback as a way to improve the work , hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so. 

- You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.

title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
description:
SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen. 

Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren. 

Wat je gaat doen 

- Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten. 

- Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen. 

- Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag. 

- Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt. 

- Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert. 

- Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit. 

- Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team. 

Wat je van ons mag verwachten 

- Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring. 

- Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan. 

- 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen. 

- Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. 

- Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage. 

- De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt. 

- Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives. 

Dit ben jij 

Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: 

- Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol. 

- Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen. 

- Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré. 

- Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool. 

- Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré. 

- Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen. 

- Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen. 

Waarom Follo? 

Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact. 

- Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong. 

- AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows. 

- Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders. 

- Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

What we’re looking for

- You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

- You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

- You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

Nice to haves 

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

title: Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau
description:
Wil jij impact maken aan de voorkant van onze uitdagende bouwprojecten? Heb je ruime technische kennis. Heb jij affiniteit met planning en prijsvorming? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau het verschil te maken! 

Dit wordt jouw baan 

Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan: 

· Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek. 

· Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject) 

· Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten 

· Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit) 

· Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers. 

· Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen. 

· Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen. 

Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving. 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer 

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. 

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. 

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. 

Hier zit je op je plek 

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten. 

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen. 

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! 

Dit breng je mee 

· Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of als bouwtechnoloog/projectorganisator. 

· Je hebt een afgeronde bouwkundige opleiding. 

· Je hebt ervaring met Asta powerproject en Revit. 

· Je hebt technisch inzicht en werkt gestructureerd. 

· Je kan goed samenwerken, neemt initiatief en denkt een stap vooruit. 

· Jij staat voor jouw oplossingen en kan deze mondeling goed toelichten aan o.a. uitvoering. 

· Je kunt snel schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en bent stressbestendig 

Deze punten geven een beeld van het profiel dat wij zoeken. Herken jij jezelf niet volledig in alle punten, maar denk je wel dat deze functie bij je past? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek. 

Dit bieden wij jou 

- Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 5.639,- €7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring is een uitloop mogelijk. 

- Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 

- Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je na 2 maanden proeftijd een onbepaalde tijd contract. 

- 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; 

- Een laptop en een smartphone. 

- Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. 

- Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. 

- Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike. 

- Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit. 

- Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. 

- Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical 

- Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. 

- Voor de generatie die een studieschuld heeft opgebouwd tijdens het nieuwe leenstelsel is er een voordelige regeling voor de aflossing van studieschuld. Je kunt jaarlijks een bedrag van je brutosalaris inleggen om je studieschuld af te lossen. Dura Vermeer verdubbelt jouw inleg.

title: (Senior) Manager People & Organisational Transformation
description:
Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness? 

At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organizational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters.

What will you do? 

Your primary focus lies in the organizational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective orgnisational design take a center stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain.

- A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree with a numerical component.

- At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy.

- At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models.

- Affinity with the translation of strategic goals into resulting implications for employees.

- Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders.

- Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills.

- Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships.

- Fluent in Dutch and English.

- 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimization of processes to designing and implementing new business models.

- Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organizational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best.

- Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management.

- Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients

- Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development.

- Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present.

- Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the Business Change Capability, and primary Organisational Transformation. 

What do we offer you? 

- Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

- An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

- Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

- Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. 

Additionally, we offer: 

- Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus of up to 4 months’ salary (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95.

- A company car or mobility budget.

- A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).

- An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.

- The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.

- A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table? 

- A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree with a numerical component.

- At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy.

description:

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

About the role: 

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

What You Will Do: 

- Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

- Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.

- Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

- Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

- Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

What You Will Bring to the Role: 

Must Haves: 

- 7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

- Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams).

- A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

- Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).

- A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

- Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

Nice to Haves: 

- Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system

- Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

- Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

- Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will: 

- Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

- Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

- Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

- Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

- Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

- Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

- Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

- Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

- Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

- Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

- Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

- Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role 

- Required Education/Certification: 

- Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

- Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves): 

- 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

- Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

- Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

- Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

- Core Competencies & Scope: 

- Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

- Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

- Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

- Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

Nice to Have Traits for this Role

- Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

- Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

- Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

- Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

- Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

- Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

- Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

- Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

Employment Requirements

- Employment Type : Full-time

- Weekly Hours : 40 h per week

- Location/Hybrid Policy : Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value 

In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

- We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

- We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

- We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

- We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

- Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

- Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

- Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

- Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

- Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

- Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

title: Senior Data Scientist — Data Cloud Acceleration
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com .

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

What you’ll do 

- 
Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset. 

- 
Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data. 

- 
Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate. 

- 
Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates. 

- 
Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services. 

- 
Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations. 

- 
Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences. 

- 
Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work. 

- 
Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results. 

- 
Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery. 

What ownership looks like at this level 

You are expected to own the deliverable . That means: 

- 
Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component 

- 
Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses 

- 
Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring 

- 
Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage 

- 
Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business 

- 
Raising risks and ambiguity early 

- 
Leaving the work in a condition that another team member can operate or extend 

You will receive guidance on broader product direction, methodology, and complex stakeholder decisions, but you should not require step-by-step direction to complete the work. 

Experience that can set you up for success 

These are useful indicators rather than absolute requirements: 

- 
Experience applying statistical analysis and machine learning to real business problems 

- 
Strong Python skills and familiarity with libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow 

- 
Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets 

- 
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, Hive, BigQuery, or similar technologies 

- 
Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, or anomaly-detection solutions 

- 
Familiarity with model evaluation, experimental design, feature engineering, and statistical validation 

- 
Experience creating repeatable batch-scoring workflows or exposing model outputs through APIs or services 

- 
Familiarity with orchestration and automation tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Prefect, or similar platforms 

- 
Experience using version control, testing, and reproducible development practices 

- 
Ability to explain analytical results and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders 

- 
Meaningful use of GenAI tools to improve the speed and quality of day-to-day work 

You’ll thrive here if you 

- 
Are pragmatic. You select the simplest credible approach that can deliver useful business impact. 

- 
Move quickly with discipline. You can produce an initial version rapidly while still validating the fundamentals. 

- 
Care about trust. You check the data, question surprising results, and make limitations visible. 

- 
Work well with ambiguity. You can turn an incomplete request into a clear set of questions, assumptions, and next steps. 

- 
Think beyond the notebook. You consider how a model will be refreshed, accessed, demonstrated, monitored, and reused. 

- 
Understand the business context. You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of client outcomes, revenue, cost, adoption, and decision quality. 

- 
Are curious and low-ego. You are comfortable learning from others, revising an approach, and using an existing solution when it is better than building a new one. 

Early indicators of success 

Within the first several months, a successful candidate will have: 

- 
Independently delivered a model, analysis workflow, or scoring component used in an active business or intelligence initiative 

- 
Added repeatable validation and documentation to their deliverables 

- 
Converted at least one exploratory analysis or prototype into a reusable workflow 

- 
Demonstrated clear understanding of how their work supports a client, product, revenue, or operational outcome 

- 
Used AI-assisted development to improve delivery speed without compromising accuracy or trust 

- 
Earned confidence from data science, application, and business partners through reliable execution and clear communication 

BENEFITS & PERKS 

- Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA 

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. 

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/

https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Unsere Kunden sind SchülerInnen, die gerade ihre Abizeitung oder ihre Abschlusstextilien planen. Für viele ist das ihr erstes großes Projekt. Im Kundensupport (m/w/d) bist du ihre erste Anlaufstelle: per Chat, Telefon und Videocall, von der ersten Frage bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, du bist überall da, wo ein Mensch gebraucht wird. Das heißt viel direkter Kontakt, schnelles Feedback und echte Verantwortung.

Aufgaben

- Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen.

- Problemlösung: Wenn etwas hakt, etwa bei Freigaben, Bestellungen oder Lieferterminen, findest du gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team eine Lösung und hältst den Jahrgang auf dem Laufenden.

- Begleitung: Du begleitest Jahrgänge von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung und sorgst dafür, dass kein Projekt untergeht.

- Video-Sprechstunden: Du führst buchbare Video-Calls, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Unterstützung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen.

- Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und hilfst dabei, Chatbot und Helpcenter besser zu machen.

- Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt. Sie melden sich nach der Schule, in der Pause oder kurz vor der Deadline. Sie brauchen jemanden, der geduldig erklärt, verlässlich zurückmeldet und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

- Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

- Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

- Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

- Du hast Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Support, idealerweise mit Endkunden. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen, etwa aus Hospitality, Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Einzelhandel oder Jugendarbeit.

- Du kannst gut mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache und geduldig, wenn dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal kommt.

- Du schreibst schnell, klar und freundlich. Am Telefon bist du genauso entspannt wie im Chat.

- Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen den Überblick. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

- Du lieferst zuverlässig und meldest dich, bevor jemand nachfragen muss.

- Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Tools wie Chat-, Ticket- oder CRM-Systemen.

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

- Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

- Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

- Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: Wenn du willst, übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung

- Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist

- Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

- 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. title: Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders)
description:
Your Mission: 

As Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders) in our Structures Team, you will lead the structural design and development of VÆRIDION’s fuselage, door, and windows work packages for our CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

Your mission is to guide a small team of engineers in delivering lightweight, manufacturable, certifiable, and production-ready structural solutions. You will be responsible for technical direction, work-package execution, team coordination, cross-functional alignment, and delivery quality within your scope.

This role combines hands-on aircraft structures expertise with strong leadership. You will not only execute engineering work yourself, but also enable others, remove blockers, anticipate risks, and represent the Structures function in internal and external discussions.

Your Day-to-Day: 

- Lead complete fuselage, doors, and windows work packages independently.

- Manage, coach, and develop a small team of structures engineers.

- Set priorities, assign tasks, track progress, and ensure high-quality delivery.

- Own technical coordination for fuselage structures, door surrounds, window cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, and installations.

- Drive design maturity from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production release.

- Anticipate and mitigate technical, schedule, manufacturing, supplier, and certification risks.

- Represent Structures in cross-functional meetings, design reviews, supplier reviews, and certification discussions.

- Align stakeholders across Stress, Systems, Production, Certification, Quality, Procurement, and external partners.

- Challenge assumptions, bring practical design improvements, and help the team make sound technical decisions.

- Review key engineering outputs, including CAD models, drawings, interface definitions, and design documentation.

- Build team capability by improving methods, standards, templates, and ways of working.

Your Profile: 

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

- 10+ years of aerospace structural design experience.

- Proven experience leading technical work packages and coordinating engineering teams.

- Strong leadership skills: clear communication, prioritization, decision-making, conflict resolution, and team development.

- Experience in at least two full aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

- Strong experience with metallic fuselage structures, aircraft doors, windows, cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, or major airframe assemblies.

- Strong understanding of metallic and composite aircraft structures, load paths, manufacturability, inspectability, repairability, and certification constraints.

- Deep proficiency in CATIA V5 or 3DX and configuration-controlled design data.

- Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures, ideally including EASA CS-23.

- Ability to anticipate risks, create clarity, align stakeholders, and deliver results through others.

- Confidence to represent the function internally and externally.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. 

Why us? 

- Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

- We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

- Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

- Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

- Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

- Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

- Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

- Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

- Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

- Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

- Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

This is a high-impact role that blends technical depth, delivery architecture and informal leadership. You will work in a complex, fast-scaling environment, and you will also help strengthen how the wider TPM team works.

Your Day-to-Day 

Own the Execution Plan: 

- Architect and design end-to-end delivery plans for your team(s), from initial discovery or design phase until commercial launch.

- Lead quarterly OKR planning and ensure it is fully aligned to company OKRs.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination: 

- Co-lead product delivery with the Product Manager and Tech Leads. You own the how and when.

- Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

Drive Risk & Decision-Making 

- Proactively identify, track, and mitigate technical and non-technical risks — timeline, resources, budget, and scope.

- Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working 

- Champion tooling and process best practices within the team and contribute workflows optimization within the TPM team. (e.g. refine the Product Development Lifecycle, Risk Management processes).

- Coach and mentor other TPMs.

Your Experience and Skills 

- Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional technical programs — ideally spanning hardware, software, and/or AI — with high delivery accountability.

- Technical Depth: Solid understanding of how complex deep-tech products are engineered across Hardware, Software and Science/AI. You can evaluate trade-offs across all three domains well enough to challenge and guide engineering decisions. A technical background in systems engineering, MRI or AI/ML is a plus.

- Practical understanding of how products are operated at customer sites, from early MVPs to mature deployments.

- Execution & Planning: Expert in building and managing master program plans, sprint structures, milestone tracking, and risk registers across multiple concurrent workstreams.

Stakeholder Management: Able to translate technical complexity into executive-level clarity and to influence and align without formal authority across matrixed organizations.

- Change Management: Proven ability to drive adoption of new tools, frameworks, and processes (e.g. PDLC/PLM rollouts, agile tooling) across cross-functional teams — balancing structured change with the pace of a fast-moving scale-up.

- Tooling & Process: Advanced setup of planning and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence, covering portfolio dashboards, cross-team dependency and risk tracking, and executive-ready reporting. Hands-on with agentic AI tools that boost team efficiency.

- Leadership & Culture: You are a servant leader who thrives in fast-growing scale-up environments, models candid communication, and creates psychological safety in high-stakes settings

What Makes You Stand Out 

Experience with deep-tech products involving AI or MRI — or direct exposure to the Food & Fresh Produce industry, particularly melons or soft fruits — is a significant plus. Familiarity with industrializing sensor-based inspection systems for high-throughput agricultural or food processing environments is highly valued.

Fit to Our Values

- We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

- We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

title: Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)
description:
Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid) 

Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start ab sofort · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office

Starte deine Sales-Karriere bei Pennylane in Berlin. Als Junior Sales Manager (intern: Sales Development Representative) arbeitest du 100 % Inbound: Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, klärst ihren Bedarf und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing lernst du den SaaS-Vertrieb von Grund auf.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision 

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext 

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

- 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

- 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

- 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

- 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

- 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

- 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns? 

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei? 

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt.

Konkret heißt das:

- Du reagierst während deiner Arbeitszeit schnell auf neue Anfragen – in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten, denn Tempo entscheidet bei Inbound über den Erfolg

- Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche (Discovery-Calls) – Unternehmensgröße, aktuelle Buchhaltung, Bedarf, Timing, Entscheider:innen – und erkennst, ob eine Anfrage zum KMU- oder zum Steuerkanzlei-Team gehört

- Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

- Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte

- Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus? 

Deine Verantwortung wächst mit dir – so sieht dein Weg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 3 Monate 

- Onboarding mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing: Du lernst Pennylane, unser Produkt, die Lead-Typen und unsere Pitches kennen

- Du führst deine ersten Calls mit Leads aus kleineren Unternehmen

Monat 4 bis 8 

- Du managst deine eigene Inbound-Pipeline in Salesforce und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Leads

- Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein und gibst Kundenfeedback an Produkt, Customer Care und Marketing weiter

Und danach … 

- Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen

- Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen 

- Du möchtest im Vertrieb durchstarten – als Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in. Erste Erfahrungen im Inside Sales, Vertriebsinnendienst oder Kundenservice sind willkommen, etwa als Junior Sales Manager, Sales Development Representative (SDR) oder Business Development Representative (BDR). Auch aus Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel bringst du wertvolle Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen mit. Vertriebserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

- Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Unternehmen funktionieren, und sprichst gern mit Unternehmer:innen

- Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – am Telefon und schriftlich

- Du bist organisiert, arbeitest gern mit Zielen und magst strukturierte Prozesse

- Du willst lernen, nimmst Feedback gern an und bleibst beim Nachfassen dran – auch wenn es mal nicht sofort klappt

- Du führst auf Deutsch souverän telefonische Beratungsgespräche und schreibst verständliche geschäftliche E-Mails; auf Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache) fühlst du dich sicher

- Erfahrung mit einem CRM (idealerweise Salesforce) ist ein Plus

Was wir bieten 

- 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start ab sofort

- 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel

- 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

- 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

- 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

- 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

- 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

- 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

- 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

- 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

- 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

- 🌍 Ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und ein starkes, gut finanziertes Mutterunternehmen in Frankreich

🤝 Bewerbungsprozess 

- Kennenlerngespräch mit Mirko, Recruiter (30 Min.)

- Zweites Gespräch mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME (30 Min.)

- Praktische Case Study und Debrief mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME, und einem Mitglied des Sales-SME-Teams (45 Min.) – keine Vorbereitung nötig; wir schauen auf Gesprächsführung und Lernfähigkeit, nicht auf Produktwissen

🇫🇷 Données personnelles 

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : 
Notre data policy 

🇬🇧 Personal Data 

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten 

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 

🇪🇸 Datos personales 

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

Deutschland ist ein zentraler Baustein unserer europäischen Expansion. Mit dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Erfolg direkt mit.

Warum wir dich suchen 

Paid Marketing ist einer unserer schnellsten Hebel, um in Deutschland qualifizierte Nachfrage aufzubauen. Bisher fehlt uns dafür eine Person, die den deutschen Markt eigenständig verantwortet und unser Wachstum bei Vertriebspipeline und monatlich wiederkehrendem Umsatz (MRR) gezielt vorantreibt.

Deine Mission 

Du baust unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise für Deutschland aus und skalierst sie über SEA, Paid Social, Display und – wo sinnvoll – Affiliate-Marketing. Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Leads zu unseren angestrebten CAC- und CPA-Werten sowie ein starker Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Dafür entwickelst du Kampagnen und Landingpages, die deutsche KMU und Steuerkanzleien gezielt ansprechen.

Du wirst Teil unseres Growth-Teams und arbeitest in der Demand-Generation-Squad . Du berichtest direkt an Hervé Gaborieau, Demand Generation Manager .

- Paid-Team in Frankreich: Du nutzt bestehende Playbooks, Kampagnenstrukturen und Erkenntnisse aus SEA und Affiliate-Marketing als Grundlage für den deutschen Markt.

- Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen.

- GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung.
