1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen 

- Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing.

- Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives.

- Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an.

2. Budget und Performance steuern 

- Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele.

- Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt.

- Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

3. Wirkung messen und kontinuierlich optimieren 

- Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter.

- Du testest laufend neue Creatives, Zielgruppen, Landingpages und Gebotsstrategien und überführst erfolgreiche Ansätze in die Skalierung.

- Mit dem Website-Team optimierst du die Landingpages und verbesserst die Conversion entlang des gesamten Funnels.

Das bringst du mit 

- Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

- Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing.

- Operative Kanalexpertise: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Ads und mindestens einer Paid-Social-Plattform wie LinkedIn oder Meta.

- Sicherheit bei Budget und Kennzahlen: Du kennst dich mit CAC, CPA, ROAS und CPL aus und weißt, wie du Budgets wirkungsvoll steuerst.

- Analytische Stärke: Attribution, Funnel-Analysen und Reporting-Tools gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Du leitest aus Daten klare Entscheidungen ab.

- Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder zweisprachigem Niveau sowie fließend Englisch.

- Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung: Du kannst den deutschen Markt eigenständig steuern und arbeitest erfolgreich mit einem verteilten, überwiegend in Frankreich ansässigen Team zusammen.

Nice to have 

- Erfahrung in einem Scale-up oder einem anderen stark wachsenden Unternehmen.

- Kenntnisse des deutschen B2B-, Fintech- oder Buchhaltungsmarkts.

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei? 

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt.

Konkret heißt das:

- Du reagierst während deiner Arbeitszeit schnell auf neue Anfragen – in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten, denn Tempo entscheidet bei Inbound über den Erfolg

- Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche (Discovery-Calls) – Unternehmensgröße, aktuelle Buchhaltung, Bedarf, Timing, Entscheider:innen – und erkennst, ob eine Anfrage zum KMU- oder zum Steuerkanzlei-Team gehört

- Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

- Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte

- Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus? 

Deine Verantwortung wächst mit dir – so sieht dein Weg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 3 Monate 

- Onboarding mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing: Du lernst Pennylane, unser Produkt, die Lead-Typen und unsere Pitches kennen

- Du führst deine ersten Calls mit Leads aus kleineren Unternehmen

Monat 4 bis 8 

- Du managst deine eigene Inbound-Pipeline in Salesforce und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Leads

- Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein und gibst Kundenfeedback an Produkt, Customer Care und Marketing weiter

Und danach … 

- Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen

- Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen 

- Du möchtest im Vertrieb durchstarten – als Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in. Erste Erfahrungen im Inside Sales, Vertriebsinnendienst oder Kundenservice sind willkommen, etwa als Junior Sales Manager, Sales Development Representative (SDR) oder Business Development Representative (BDR). Auch aus Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel bringst du wertvolle Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen mit. Vertriebserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

- Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Unternehmen funktionieren, und sprichst gern mit Unternehmer:innen

- Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – am Telefon und schriftlich

- Du bist organisiert, arbeitest gern mit Zielen und magst strukturierte Prozesse

- Du willst lernen, nimmst Feedback gern an und bleibst beim Nachfassen dran – auch wenn es mal nicht sofort klappt

- Du führst auf Deutsch souverän telefonische Beratungsgespräche und schreibst verständliche geschäftliche E-Mails; auf Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache) fühlst du dich sicher

- Erfahrung mit einem CRM (idealerweise Salesforce) ist ein Plus

Was wir bieten 

- 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start ab sofort

- 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel

- 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

- 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

- 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

- 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

- 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

- 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

- 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

- 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

- 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

- 🌍 Ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und ein starkes, gut finanziertes Mutterunternehmen in Frankreich

🤝 Bewerbungsprozess 

- Kennenlerngespräch mit Mirko, Recruiter (30 Min.)

- Zweites Gespräch mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME (30 Min.)

- Praktische Case Study und Debrief mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME, und einem Mitglied des Sales-SME-Teams (45 Min.) – keine Vorbereitung nötig; wir schauen auf Gesprächsführung und Lernfähigkeit, nicht auf Produktwissen

🇫🇷 Données personnelles 

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : 
Notre data policy 

🇬🇧 Personal Data 

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten 

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 

🇪🇸 Datos personales 

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Marketing Lead - B2B Demand Generation & Growth (m/w/d) - Remote
description:
Über uns

ZEP ist eine cloudbasierte Software für Projektcontrolling – von der Projektzeiterfassung über Abwesenheitsverwaltung bis zur Abrechnung. Mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen, vor allem projektorientierte Dienstleister wie Beratungen, IT- und Engineering-Unternehmen, arbeiten bereits mit ZEP.

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2000 sind wir inhabergeführt und kontinuierlich gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen und noch mehr Unternehmen von ZEP überzeugen. Als Marketing Lead entwickelst du die passenden Ideen und Maßnahmen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und unser Wachstum aktiv voranzutreiben.

Du willst Marketing nicht nur umsetzen, sondern verantworten – mit klaren Pipeline-Zielen, eigenem Budget und einem Team, das du weiterentwickelst?

Als Marketing Lead bei ZEP übernimmst du die Ergebnisverantwortung für unser Marketing und die daraus entstehende Pipeline. Du führst das Marketingteam sowie unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister, steuerst das Marketingbudget und greifst aktiv ein, wenn Zahlen vom Plan abweichen.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität dort, wo es darauf ankommt.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du verantwortest unsere Pipeline-Ziele und das Marketingbudget und steuerst aktiv gegen, wenn Zahlen abweichen.

- Du entwickelst die Marketingstrategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung, schärfst Positionierung und Messaging für unsere B2B-Zielgruppen und leitest daraus Ziele und Prioritäten ab.

- Als Teil des Management-Teams bringst du die Marketingperspektive in strategische Entscheidungen auf Unternehmensebene ein und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von ZEP aktiv mit.

- Du führst das Marketingteam, setzt Prioritäten und entwickelst die Teammitglieder fachlich und persönlich weiter.

- Du steuerst und forderst unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister – insbesondere im Paid-Bereich (z. B. Google Ads, Paid Social) – mit klaren Zielen und Briefings und misst sie an ihren Ergebnissen.

- Du baust Demand Generation über mehrere Kanäle auf, nicht nur über Paid.

- Du verbesserst gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb die Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Sales.

- Du sorgst für sauberes Tracking und Attribution über den gesamten Funnel.

- Du wertest Kampagnen, Funnel und Conversion Rates aus – wenn nötig selbst in HubSpot und im Tracking – und leitest daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

- Du entwickelst SEO und die Sichtbarkeit in KI-Suchen (AI Search) als wachsenden Kanal weiter.

- Du entwickelst unsere Website weiter und holst mehr Leads aus dem vorhandenen Traffic.

Deine Voraussetzungen

- Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing mit, mit Schwerpunkt Demand Generation.

- Du hast nachweislich Pipeline- oder Umsatzziele erreicht und hattest Budgetverantwortung.

- Du hast bereits Führungserfahrung gesammelt: Du hast ein Marketingteam geführt, Prioritäten gesetzt und Mitarbeitende weiterentwickelt.

- Du hast Erfahrung darin, Agenturen und Dienstleister zu steuern und fachlich zu fordern.

- Du kennst dich mit Performance Marketing (Google Ads, Paid Social) so gut aus, dass du Agenturen auf Augenhöhe führst.

- Du bist sicher in Analyse, Tracking und Attribution; idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit HubSpot.

- Du setzt KI selbstverständlich in deiner Arbeit ein und weißt, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringt.

- Du bringst eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher verständigen.

Deine Benefits

- 30 Tage Urlaub und unbefristete Arbeitsverträge

- Remote First Company – Arbeite innerhalb Deutschlands von wo du möchtest!

- Unterstützung bei der Home-Office Einrichtung

- Chancen, Freiheiten und Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten eines Startups verbunden mit der Sicherheit eines seit über 20 Jahren etablierten Unternehmens im Mittelstand.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Keine Kernarbeitszeiten, stimme dich einfach mit dem Team ab.

- Windows oder Mac? Entscheide selbst!

- 50 EUR monatlicher Gutschein für verschiedene Sachbezüge oder Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

- Jobrad mit Arbeitgeber-Zuschuss

- offene team- und ergebnisorientierte Kultur

- regelmäßige Workshops, Mittagessen und Events zum Teambuilding

- Individuelle Altersvorsorgepläne

Wenn du dich in den Anforderungen wiederfindest und diesen Bereich aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Senior SAP FICO Consultant (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for an experienced SAP functional Consultant (m/f/d) to join our ERP Finance team at Flix, in Berlin or Munich. 

In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, the ERP Finance team is responsible for the platform that powers our financial backbone: accounting, controlling, procurement, period close, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of Flix. We're setting up a new ERP system for our Train business (FlixTrain) with a first focus on Finance and Procurement. 

As our in-house SAP expert, you'll work closely with our Finance and Procurement teams as well as external partners to make sure the new ERP fits our needs: today and in the long run. After go-live, you'll be the person who owns, evolves and continuously improves the SAP solution from the inside. 

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and combining solid SAP craftsmanship with a long-term, in-house perspective 

About the Role 

- Act as Flix's in-house SAP expert during the implementation of our new ERP, with a focus on Finance and Procurement. 

- Translate business requirements from Finance, Procurement and adjacent functions into clean, scalable SAP solutions. 

- Work closely with external implementation partners during design, build, testing and cut over. 

- Support data migration, test management, and go-live preparation from a Flix-side ownership perspective. 

- Take long-term ownership of the SAP solution after go-live: enhancements, change requests, integrations and continuous process improvement. 

- Contribute to building broader SAP capability within the ERP Finance team thought teaching and mentoring. 

- Be a trusted advisor to Finance and Procurement stakeholders on what SAP can do for 

About You 

- 7+ years of experience as an SAP Consultant (incl. 5+ years in S/4HANA), with a strong focus on Finance (FI/CO) and Procurement (MM). 

- Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. 

- Additional working knowledge in SAP Supply Chain and Asset Management modules. 

- At least two full end-to-end SAP implementations, ideally in a company of similar size and complexity to Flix. 

- Solid understanding of core finance and procurement processes: General Ledger, Accounts Payable / Receivable, Fixed Assets, Controlling, Purchase-to-Pay. 

- Experience working with external system integrators and the confidence to engage with them as an equal partner. 

- Comfortable engaging with senior Finance and Procurement stakeholders and translating between business and SAP language. 

- Structured, pragmatic, delivery-oriented; strong communication and facilitation skills. 

- Based in Germany, you're fluent in German and English. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer 

- Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

- Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

- Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

- Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

- Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

- Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career 

Why Join Flix? 

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. 
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. 

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Senior Medical Content Writer (x/f/m)
description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Senior Medical Content Writer (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für das Patient Content Factory Team in Berlin. 

Doctolib ist Europas führender Health Companion und begleitet Millionen von Patient:innen und Gesundheitsfachkräften auf dem gesamten Kontinent. Wir transformieren die Gesundheitsversorgung, indem wir unsere Plattform mit innovativen Lösungen rund um Prävention und Patient:innen-Empowerment bereichern.

Unser nächster Schritt: Doctolib zur vertrauenswürdigsten Gesundheitskontent-Destination in Europa zu machen. Dafür haben wir das Patient Content Factory Team ins Leben gerufen — ein dediziertes Team, das für alle Inhalte innerhalb der Doctolib-App verantwortlich ist. Dies umfasst Präventionskampagnen sowie personalisierte Gesundheitsinformationen (Artikel, Videos, interaktive Inhalte), die auf verifizierten medizinischen Kenntnissen basieren.

Du verantwortlich für das Verfassen und die Verwaltung von Inhalten für den Health Companion der App — und stellst dabei höchste Qualitätsstandards sicher. Du koordinierst funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder, sorgst für End-to-End-Qualität an allen Touchpoints und steuerst die gesamte Content-Produktion.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du hilfst beim Aufbau und der Pflege des Redaktionskalenders für alle deutschen Gesundheitsinhalte und identifizierst Content-Möglichkeiten basierend auf Patient:innen-Bedürfnissen und öffentlichen Gesundheitsprioritäten

- Du schreibst und erstellst verständliche medizinische Inhalte für Patient:innen und übersetzt komplexe medizinische Informationen in klare, handlungsorientierte Artikel für das deutsche Publikum

- Du managst den gesamten Content-Workflow von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Writer:innen für eine termingerechte Umsetzung

- Du verwaltest Inhalte und Redaktionskalender über ein CMS und treibst die Optimierung von Content-Prozessen durch Automatisierung und KI voran

- Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Inhalte höchste Standards in Bezug auf Genauigkeit, Klarheit und Healthcare-Compliance erfüllen, und koordinierst strenge Review-Prozesse mit medizinischen Gutachter:innen und Expert:innen

- Du trägst zum Aufbau eines Netzwerks aus glaubwürdigen Partner:innen (Institutionen, Expert:innen, medizinische Fachgesellschaften) bei, um die Autorität von Doctolibs Gesundheitsinhalten zu stärken

Dein Profil 

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen! 

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit: 

- Abschluss in Kommunikation, Journalismus oder Lebenswissenschaften (Biomedizin, Public Health o.ä.)

- Mindestens 4 Jahre nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Bereich Medical Content Writing, Gesundheitskommunikation oder verwandten Feldern

- Erfahrung im Management digitaler Kampagnen und in der Arbeit mit CMS-Systemen

- Starker Projektmanagement-Hintergrund mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Stakeholder zu koordinieren

- Herausragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

- Neugier und Interesse an multiformat-Storytelling (Video, interaktive Inhalte) — praktische Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung mit Performance-Measurement-Tools

- Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen, funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld zu navigieren

Was wir Dir bieten 

- Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest

- 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

- Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten

- Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

- Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

- Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

- Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

- Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

- Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

- Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

- Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interviewprozess 

- Interview mit dem Talent Team (auf Englisch)

- Interview mit der Hiring Managerin (auf Deutsch)

- Case Study (auf Deutsch)

- Abschlussgespräch

- Referenzprüfung oder Arbeitszeugnis

Job Details 

- Festanstellung

- Vollzeit

- Standort: Berlin

- Hybride Arbeitsweise (3 Tage Office/Woche)

- Startdatum: Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert. 

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) 

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI 

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users 

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve 

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end 

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

- You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

- You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

- You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

- You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

- FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

- We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

- We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

- We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

- We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

- Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

Benefits

- Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

- Remote-first , flexible work hours , async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture 

- Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

- Stock options

- 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

- Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

- Co-working budget or home office setup

- Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here .

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

- €88k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

- €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook . There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

Compensation: €79K – €105K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

- Similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine, etc. • €79K – €97K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager (App Installs)
description:
Who We Are 

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role 

Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll manage paid media channels to drive profitable acquisition of new app users, aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

- Scaling and optimizing app acquisition campaigns in Google, Microsoft and Apple ad platforms 

- Launching new ad channel tests and measuring incremental lift 

- Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging to improve app install conversion

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable user growth. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, app acquisition, subscriber growth, paid advertising, and creative testing. Responsibilities may also include owning a portfolio of existing channels (Google ads, paid social, app install campaigns) with the goal of efficiently scaling profitable advertising. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. You know how to use aggregate measurement, experimentation, and strong judgment rather than user-level targeting and tracking.

About You 

- 7+ years of experience in digital advertising roles with 2+ years of experience in marketing consumer apps preferred.

- Hands-on expertise standing up and managing paid digital advertising programs (Google Ads, Apple Ads, etc.) as well as familiarity with non-digital paid media management (CTV, TV, etc.).

- Demonstrated track record of profitably scaling app install growth programs while improving efficiency and unit economics as volume materially scales.

- Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics.

- Experience designing and running incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies, PSA/ghost ads) to validate true channel impact and guide investment decisions.

- Advanced analytical abilities, including modeling app economics (payback, LTV), data analysis, scenario planning, and projecting campaign outcomes across spend and volume curves.

- Track record of running creative testing as an always on pipeline, consistently shipping new concepts to prevent performance decay and unlock incremental scale.

- Passion for ideating and problem solving to deliver creative solutions for profitable user growth.

- Excellent communication skills — you can clearly articulate recommendations and rationale, whether verbal or written.

Compensation 

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation, plus stock options: 

- United States: $190,500 USD

- United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP

- Canada: CA$253,500 CAD

- All other regions*: €157,350 EUR

*Team members outside the US, UK and Canada are currently paid $178,500 USD. Pay converts to the EUR amount above on January 1, 2027 for Spanish team members, and approximately February 1, 2027 in all other regions.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. 

Hiring Process 

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire .

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to 

Please note that 

- You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

- Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

- While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

- A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

- By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process 

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles: 

- Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy . We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

- Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

- Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at Compensation: $178.5K • Offers Equity

At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. 

We are looking for a Solutions Architect to own end-to-end solution design and technical leadership for TYTAN's C-UAS systems. This is a senior architecture role: you will design how our systems integrate into customer IT, C2, and service-management environments, and you will be the technical authority other architects and engineers look to on complex, multi-stakeholder programs.

- Own end-to-end solution architecture for TYTAN's C-UAS systems and their integration into customer IT and C2 environments. 

- Apply NAF v4 and/or ADMBw architecture frameworks to structure customer-facing and internal solution designs. 

- Design and govern the full IT-service lifecycle, from requirements through deployment, operations, and decommissioning. 

- Architect solutions spanning cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. 

- Lead and mentor internal and external architects and technical teams across complex programs. 

- Apply TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL practices to structure architecture governance and IT service management processes. 

- Represent TYTAN's technical architecture to customers, partners, and integrators. 

- Defense-sector experience is mandatory; a former military background is strongly preferred. 

- Practical, hands-on experience with Sparx Enterprise Architect , NAF v4 and/or ADMBw. 

- Strong IT, software, or systems architecture background. 

- At least 5 years of relevant experience in solution architecture or technical IT consulting. 

- Experience with TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL; relevant certifications preferred. 

- Experience designing complex IT service-management platforms and processes. 

- Experience with cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. 

- Demonstrated ability to lead internal and external architects and technical teams. 

- Fluent German and English. 

Why TYTAN? 

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security 

- Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale 

- Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors 

- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback 

- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact 

- Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company 

- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe 

Our Benefits 

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation 

- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit 

- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us 

- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team 

- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together 

- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands 

- Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration 

About us

title: Head of Sales (m/w/d) AI-Startup
description:
Du kannst gut verkaufen? Dann könnten wir gut Matchen. 

Wir suchen einen Head of Sales auf selbstständiger Basis , zunächst ideal als Nebenjob. Du hast die Chance, früh in ein internationales AI-Startup einzusteigen, ein Vertriebsteam aufzubauen und dies für den gesamten deutschen Markt zu leiten. Zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt ist auf Wunsch ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag + Fixgehalt vorgesehen.

Über uns 

Wir sind ein Startup und arbeiten überwiegend remote. Optional kannst du auch vor Ort aus Hamburg, London oder Prag mit uns arbeiten.

Aktuell bauen wir Fenie auf, eine innovative KI-Assistentin speziell für Kosmetikstudios und Unternehmen aus der Beauty-Branche. Fenie hilft die Beauty Branche dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation zu automatisieren.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sale (m/w/d), der Vertrieb im Blut hat und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

Vergütung & Perspektive 

Aktuell bieten wir kein fixes Grundgehalt, da wir uns noch in der Growth-Phase befinden. Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt daher auf selbstständiger Basis , (siehe unten unter „Vergütung“). 

Damit bietet gleichzeitig bewusst einige Vorteile für diejenigen, die an unserem Wachstum partizipieren möchten.

Du kannst ein eigenes Vertriebsteam aufbauen und zusätzlich an dessen Provisionen mitverdienen. Dazu kommen deine eigene Provision sowie wiederkehrende Provisionen, die deutlich höher ausfallen als bei vergleichbaren Jobangeboten.

Bei unserem zweiten Startup verdienen unsere Kollegen, die Head of Sales Mitarbeiter aktuell zwischen 6.000 und 7.000 € im Monat , ein realistischer Einblick dafür, was nach einer kurzen Zeit möglich ist.

Was du mitbringen solltest 

- Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Vertrieb

- Erfahrung in der aktiven Neukundenakquise, insbesondere Telefonakquise und Cold Calling

- Du hast bereits nachweislich Erfahrung darin, potenzielle Kunden aktiv anzusprechen und für ein Produkt oder eine Dienstleistung zu gewinnen

- Sicherer Umgang mit Einwandbehandlung und Follow-ups

- Im besten Fall Erfahrungen in der Beauty und Software Bernache

- Absolut Zuverlässigkeit

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du kontaktierst Kosmetik, Beauty- und ähnliche Studios telefonisch durch Cold Calling. Eine freundliche und meist lockere Zielgruppe.

- Leads stellen wir zu Verfügung

- Du stellst Fenie potenziellen Kunden vor

- Du erklärst einfach und verständlich, welchen Mehrwert KI im Alltag bietet

- Du baust auf Wunsch ein Team auf uns leitest dies

- Du arbeitest neue Vertriebsmitarbeiter ein

Was dich bei Fenie erwartet 

- Ein schnell wachsendes AI-Startup

- 100 % Remote, innerhalb Europa

- Die Möglichkeit, das gesamtes Vertriebsteam für den deutschen Markt zu leiten

- Flexible Zeiteinteilung innerhalb unserer Vertriebszeiten zwischen 9 und 17 Uhr

- Hohes Provisionsmodell durch hohe Margen im Softwaregeschäft

- Wiederkehrende hohe Provisionen sind Standard

- Einstieg in einer frühen Startup-Phase

Vergütung 

· 50 % Provision auf Erstzahlungen

· 20 % Provision auf monatlich wiederkehrende Zahlungen (unsere AI verkaufen wir ausschließlich im Abo Modelle und mit Jahresplänen)

· 10 % Provision auf Umsätze deines Vertriebsteams, was du führen kannst - deutschlandweit

Interesse? 

Schreib uns einfach kurz, wer du bist, welche Vertriebserfahrung du mitbringst und warum du Lust darauf hast, Fenie gemeinsam mit uns aufzubauen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Dein Fenie Team

title: Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

We're scaling incredibly fast, and our manufacturing capability is central to our future. As our Talent Partner, you'll be focused on hiring workers across the manufacturing lifecycle. 

What You Will Do

title: Chief Engineer
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability 

At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

That is where you come in. 

As Chief Engineer, you will be one of the most important technical leaders at Hypersonica. You will hold the vehicle in your head as a complete system and take responsibility for ensuring that what we design can actually work, integrate, be tested and ultimately fly. 

This is not a role for someone who wants to govern engineering from a distance. You will work directly with exceptional engineers, get deep into difficult technical problems and make consequential decisions with incomplete information. You will challenge assumptions, resolve conflicts between disciplines and keep the overall architecture coherent as the vehicle evolves at pace. 

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. You may have grown through Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle design or another deeply technical discipline. What matters is that you have developed the breadth, judgement and technical credibility to make decisions at whole-vehicle level. 

If you have spent your career building systems that people initially thought were too difficult, too ambitious or too fast to deliver, we want to hear from you. 

What you'll do 

- Own the technical integrity of Hypersonica’s flight vehicles from system concept through design, integration, test and flight. 

- Define and continuously evolve the overall vehicle architecture, ensuring that mission objectives translate into a coherent physical and functional system. 

- Act as the senior technical authority across vehicle-level engineering decisions, trade-offs, interfaces and risk. 

- Ensure GNC, avionics, electronics, software, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, thermal systems, power and payloads work together as a single integrated vehicle. 

- Drive the definition and decomposition of mission and system requirements, focusing on the requirements that genuinely determine whether the vehicle succeeds. 

- Own the critical interfaces between systems and resolve technical conflicts when optimisation within one discipline damages performance somewhere else. 

- Lead major system-level trades around performance, mass, power, thermal constraints, controllability, reliability, manufacturability and operational capability. 

- Work closely with GNC and avionics teams to ensure sensing, estimation, control, computing, actuation and vehicle dynamics form a robust closed-loop system. 

- Challenge designs from first principles rather than accepting assumptions because they are conventional or inherited from previous programmes. 

- Lead technical readiness for major design reviews, integration milestones and flight tests. 

- Use test and flight data aggressively, turning unexpected behaviour and failures into design improvements rather than paperwork. 

- Work directly with Manufacturing and AIT to make sure the vehicle being designed can actually be built, integrated, tested and iterated quickly. 

- Make difficult technical decisions when information is incomplete, balancing engineering rigour with the speed required to deliver breakthrough capability. 

Who you are 

- An exceptional multidisciplinary engineer who naturally thinks at system and vehicle level rather than only within a single subsystem. 

- Deeply technically credible, with a strong foundation in areas such as Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle architecture or complex aerospace system design. 

- Experienced taking complex aerospace, defence, space, autonomous or similarly high-consequence systems from concept into real integrated hardware. 

- Strong in system architecture, requirements, interfaces, integration, verification and technical risk. 

- Comfortable reasoning about closed-loop vehicle behaviour, including the relationship between vehicle dynamics, sensors, estimation, control, actuators and onboard computing. 

- Able to understand a difficult technical problem quickly, identify the assumptions that actually matter and drive the team towards an answer. 

- Experienced making significant engineering trade-offs across multiple disciplines rather than optimising one component in isolation. 

- Comfortable moving between first-principles technical discussion and major programme-level decisions without losing depth. 

- Willing to get personally involved when a problem matters. You do not need a large team, perfect information or an established process before you can make progress. 

- Able to distinguish engineering rigour from engineering bureaucracy. 

- Confident challenging exceptional specialists in their own disciplines while remaining open enough to change your own mind when the evidence demands it. 

- Calm when things go wrong, intellectually honest when something is not understood and relentless about finding the real answer. 

- Motivated by the opportunity to build sovereign European defence capability and comfortable working on systems where the consequences of engineering decisions genuinely matter. 

You might have come from 

There is no single route to becoming the right Chief Engineer for Hypersonica. 

You may currently be a Chief Engineer, Systems Architect, Head of Systems Engineering, GNC Lead, Avionics Lead, Flight Controls Lead, Vehicle Architect or Principal Engineer . 

You may have spent your career in missiles, high-speed flight, combat aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous systems or another environment where complex physical systems need to work first time. 

We are less interested in your current title than in the scale of the technical problems you have personally solved. 

What we offer 

- The opportunity to hold genuine technical ownership of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes. 

- A company early enough that your decisions will materially shape the vehicles, engineering organisation and technical culture we build. 

- Direct access to the problem. Short decision paths, minimal bureaucracy and engineers empowered to solve engineering problems. 

- Daily collaboration with exceptional people across GNC, avionics, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, manufacturing, test and defence. 

- The freedom to challenge convention, build from first principles and move quickly when the evidence supports it. 

- The resources and ambition to attempt things that would take significantly longer in traditional aerospace organisations. 

- The opportunity to see your decisions move from a whiteboard, into hardware and ultimately into flight. 

The person we are looking for 

We are not looking for someone to simply approve other people’s engineering. 

We are looking for the person engineers turn to when the disciplines disagree, the data is incomplete, the deadline is real and somebody has to understand the whole system well enough to make the call. 

Someone who can bring clarity to complexity without slowing the organisation down. 

If that sounds like you, come and build it with us.

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.

We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on. 

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. We are looking for a Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality. 

What is our mission? 

We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One`s destiny. We are Insider One’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley.

What are we offering? 

Impact ; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day.

Personal Growth ; work closely with experienced PMs, get mentored by some of the best people in their fields, join tons of different training like sales, design, customer communication. Develop the skills that you need to become a successful product manager.

Experience ; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things to become a great product manager, experience.

Delight ; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them.

Community ; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community.

What are we searching for? 

Leadership , you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction.

Communication , you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to.

Problem Solving , you are a natural-born problem solver, finding solutions to complex problems motivates and excites you, and at that moment when you solve the problem, feeling that sense of accomplishment is worth all the effort.

Teamwork , you are easily able to work with people around you, help them when they need, give or take constructive feedback, despite any personal conflict between you and them. 

Listening , despite the fact that communicating effectively is extremely important, you should also be able to gather information from many sources around you to help you make better-informed decisions on guiding and improving your products and services.

Entrepreneurial Spirit , rather than waiting to adapt to change, you are actively seeking out change. You have a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and improvement. You can see the big picture, you are willing to take risks, you constantly seek new opportunities for innovation and you take ownership and pride in what you do. What are you going to do?

What You Will Do 

- Define the why , when , and what of the products our engineering team builds, leading cross-functional teams from ideation to launch.

- Build a product and strategy that reflect Insider One’s vision , clearly articulating business value to align the team around each release.

- Own and optimize the release process , coordinating all activities to bring products to market successfully.

- Manage and prioritize initiatives, turning insights into actionable ideas by continuously tracking market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies.

- Define and analyze key product metrics to measure performance, customer satisfaction, and improvement opportunities.

What You Will Need 

- A Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university, preferably in Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.

- 3+ years of Product Management experience , preferably with a B2B SaaS product .

- Hands-on experience in Agile Product Development .

- Exceptional decision-making and communication skills.

- The ability to manage complex initiatives with limited supervision.

- Fluent in English and Turkish , both written and verbal, as we have colleagues from all over the world.

What We Offer 

- Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.

- Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.

- Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.

- Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.

- Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.

- Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.

- From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.

- Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks.

We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there. 

To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer who enjoys writing code, solving complex problems, and building tools that help teams deliver with confidence. Reporting to the Quality Director of Tech, you will help establish our QE capabilities through hands-on development of automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and quality insights across mobile, Unity, APIs, integrations, performance, and CI/CD.

You will help build our Quality Engineering capabilities incrementally, prioritizing the areas of greatest risk and value with the team. We are building these capabilities while supporting an active live-service game. You will take ownership of immediate testing needs, including manual, exploratory, and release validation, while developing sustainable automation and tooling. A willingness to test directly is essential. You will use what you learn to guide automation priorities, while recognizing the continuing value of exploratory testing, and develop practical AI capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness.

What You Will Do

- Build reusable engineering solutions. Write, review, debug, and maintain automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that other engineers can adopt and extend.

- Improve testability from the start. Participate in technical design and code reviews to identify risks early and improve test hooks, service interfaces, and diagnostic capabilities.

- Balance building with hands-on testing. Perform manual, exploratory, and release testing where automation is not yet available or direct investigation provides greater value. Meet current delivery needs while building sustainable solutions.

- Develop mobile and Unity automation. Automate Android, iOS, and Unity workflows, accounting for device differences, application lifecycle events, network conditions, and client performance.

- Strengthen API and integration testing. Validate backend services, service contracts, client-server interactions, data integrity, and failure recovery through reliable automated tests.

- Investigate failures across systems. Use logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, and telemetry to investigate client, backend, and integration failures, support root-cause analysis, and turn findings into regression coverage.

- Validate mobile and backend performance. Profile frame rate, memory usage, application startup, crashes, and responsiveness. Develop backend load, stress, and endurance tests, establish meaningful baselines, and investigate bottlenecks and regressions with engineers.

- Apply risk-based testing. Prioritize validation by player impact, technical complexity, change scope, and failure history. Combine service-level tests, targeted end-to-end automation, and exploratory testing.

- Integrate validation into CI/CD. Deliver reliable automated feedback, useful diagnostics, and maintainable quality checks. Improve test stability and execution time, with clear ownership of failures.

- Improve test data and environments. Build utilities, fixtures, and repeatable setup processes that make testing dependable and defects easier to reproduce.

- Develop AI-assisted quality workflows. Build and evaluate solutions for test generation, failure triage, regression selection, and coverage analysis, with human review and measurable outcomes.

- Strengthen telemetry validation and quality visibility. Partner with engineering and analytics to validate telemetry accuracy, completeness, duplicates, schema changes, and data freshness. Query large datasets to investigate issues and build quality dashboards that inform risk assessment and release decisions.

- Help establish the QE organization. Contribute standards, documentation, reusable patterns, and mentoring. Partner with developers, Quality Analysts, and technical leaders to strengthen shared ownership of quality.

What We're Looking For

- Demonstrated quality engineering, software development in test, or software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of automation used by other engineers.

- Practical experience testing and automating Android and iOS applications, including device coverage, operating system differences, and unreliable network conditions.

- Experience developing API and integration tests, diagnosing failures across services and data flows, and integrating reliable automated tests into CI/CD.

- Working knowledge of performance, risk-based, and exploratory testing, with sound judgment about what to automate and when to investigate directly.

- Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with telemetry and big data, including querying large datasets, validating events and data pipelines, and using findings to guide testing and release decisions.

- Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and the ability to evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.

- Strong ownership and collaborative problem-solving, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions. A passion for quality, mobile games, AI, and technology.

- Advanced professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to participate independently in technical discussions, explain engineering decisions, and write clear documentation with global teams.

Additional experience we value

- Hands-on experience with Unity, C#, Unity Test Framework, or automated testing of Unity-based mobile games.

- Experience with live-service games, player-state consistency, reconnect behavior, live configuration, or client-server synchronization.

- Experience with mobile device farms, observability, quality dashboards, or establishing QE capabilities within a growing team.

What success looks like

Teams receive faster, more trustworthy feedback and clearer visibility into release risk. Immediate testing needs are met while dependable automation grows around critical player journeys and integrations. Performance regressions surface earlier, failures are easier to diagnose, and repetitive effort decreases. Your tools are maintained, documented, and adopted by other engineers, and AI capabilities demonstrate measurable value.

Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days) 

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

- Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

- Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

- Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

- Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

- Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

- Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

- Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

- Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

- Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

- Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

- Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

- Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

- Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

- Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

- Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

#LI-FYX

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
The Role 

Procurement and supply chain is a $3 trillion market still running on outdated systems and manual processes. Magentic is changing that.

We’re building a new generation of agentic AI that works inside the world’s largest and most complex organisations, backed by Sequoia and built by a team from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We’re early, moving fast and already solving real problems for global enterprises.

As a Deployment Strategist , you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment.

You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale.

What You’ll Do 

You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests.

- Own deployments end-to-end —design the rollout strategy at household-name enterprises, run the programme, and change course decisively when the approach isn't landing.

- Hold the senior relationships —be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations.

- Find the value nobody has scoped —go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next.

- Define best practice for AI deployment —set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale.

- Shape our roadmap —bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build.

You Might Be a Great Fit if You 

- Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role

- Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted

- Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue

- Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information

- Communicate exceptionally well, both in the room with a VP and in a written handover to a colleague

Bonus Points 

- Have experience deploying AI, automation, or data products inside large organisations

- Are familiar with procurement, supply chain, or finance functions in enterprise settings

Compensation and Benefits 

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

- Competitive Equity : play a real part in Magentic’s upside

- A salary of £100-110k 

- Enhanced parental leave 

- 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown

- In-office lunches provided 

- Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes 

- Hybrid London HQ (4 days per week onsite, with flex if you have appointments etc)

- Annual team retreat —a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build

Our Interview Process 

We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

- Initial call (30 mins) : this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

- Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.

- In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement 

At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone.

Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

Responsible AI Statement
At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.
