title: Enterprise Account Executive III - Netherlands
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.

You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

- Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

- Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

- Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

- Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

- Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

- Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

- Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

- Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists.

- Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

- Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

- Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like

First 30 days 

- Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

- Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

- Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

- Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days 

- Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

- Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

- Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

- Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

- Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond 

- Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

- Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

- Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

- Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

- Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

- Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves 

- 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

- Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

- A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

- Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

- Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

- A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves 

- Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

- Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

- Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

- Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

- Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
description:
Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! 

Jouw rol 
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).

Jouw werkzaamheden 

- In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.

- Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.

- Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).

- Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.

- Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten.

Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland 

Wie zijn wij? 
Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. 

Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden 
Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/ 

Jouw profiel 

- Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijv. Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, IT, Data of Finance)

- Je zoekt een 3e of 4e jaars stage waarbij de nadruk ligt op meewerken of bouwen van dashboarding

- Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data

- Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate

- Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk

- Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst

- Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen

Wat bieden wij jou? 
Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende:

- Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime

- 2 verlofdagen per maand

- Flexibiliteit en vrijheid

- Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,23ct per kilometer tussen 5- en 60km enkele reis

- Laptop voor gebruik bij Heras

Iets voor jou? 
Als je graag meer informatie wil ontvangen over de vacature of sollicitatieprocedure neem dan contact op met onze Corporate Recruiter Bram Smits via 0629148655.

Voor externe partijen: Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Heras behoudt hiermee het recht om ingestuurde kandidaten rechtstreeks te benaderen.

title: Senior AWS Platform Engineer
Android Developer
description:
At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with our colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer, you will help us build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role

As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

- Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

- Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns.

- Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early.

- Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

- Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable.

- Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues.

- Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

- Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

- Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii .

- Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

- You have at least five years of experience in Android or mobile development and extensive experience with Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow.

- You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment.

- You have experience with clean architecture, software design patterns and approaches such as MVVM or MVI, and you understand how to apply them in maintainable mobile applications.

- You have experience with Jetpack Compose, mobile unit and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and Android design guidelines.

- You understand mobile performance and reliability, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation, as well as working with web services, cloud platforms and APIs.

- You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

- English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now! 

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via 

What does the recruitment process look like? 

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

- Lead annual OpEx budget cycles and recurring reforecasts. Build dynamic, driver-based forecasting models and support Long-Range Planning (LRP) scenario modeling. 

- Consolidate OpEx, workforce, and revenue forecasts into a single defensible group view in TM1. Support the FP&A Director in presenting to the CFO, ELT, and Board.

- 5-7+ years in finance with 2–3+ years in FP&A. Experience owning end-to-end close/budget cycles and partnering directly with non-finance stakeholders. 

- Tech, SaaS, or scale-up background strongly preferred. 

- Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills. Hands-on experience with corporate planning tools (TM1/Cognos is a strong plus; Anaplan/Adaptive) and ERP systems (NetSuite preferred). Strong grasp of core accounting concepts (accruals, prepayments, opex vs. capex). 

- Commercial mindset, structured thinking, strong communication skills, and the confidence to challenge budget assumptions constructively.

title: Senior Finance Manager
description:
About GRI 

Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) is the independent nonprofit organization that is the architect of the common global language to assess and report on environmental, social, and economic impacts. GRI provides standards, tools, and training that empower organizations of all sizes to create sustainable, long-term value and unlock positive change in the world. 

For over 25 years, GRI has led a global multi-stakeholder process to develop and refine rigorous yet practical approaches to sustainability reporting, which meet the needs of all stakeholders. The  GRI Standards, the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards, provide the building blocks for transparent reporting on impacts. Working at GRI, you will be part of unlocking positive change in the world.  

About the role 

The Senior Manager Finance owns budgeting and financial analysis to support the CFO and budget holders in business decision-making. The role also oversees day-to-day finance operations, financial controls and external reporting, and provides line management and guidance to a finance colleague. 

Driving automation and process improvement is a central part of the role, using digital tools and AI where appropriate to streamline workflows, automate reporting and reduce manual work. Initially focused on finance, this remit may expand to other processes across GRI in the longer term. 

Responsibilities 

Delivery 

- Own and deliver the budgeting, forecasting and financial planning cycle, providing the CFO with robust analysis, scenario modelling, automated dashboards and clear recommendations, while automating data collection and reporting to reduce manual effort and support business decision-making. 

- Lead process improvement and automation across finance, using digital tools and AI where appropriate to reduce manual work and improve accuracy, timeliness and efficiency, and extend this to other administrative processes across the organization in the longer term. 

- Maintain strong financial controls, building automated checks and workflows where possible, and, with support from the finance and grant management teams, manage external reporting including consolidated financial statements (under IFRS for SMEs), tax reporting and donor financial reporting. 

- Provide line management, guidance and development to a finance colleague, overseeing day-to-day finance operations (including payments, reconciliations and month-end close) and coaching them to streamline and automate routine tasks. 

Engagement 

- Act as a finance business partner to budget holders, providing insight into performance, challenging assumptions and supporting informed resource allocation. 

- Support the CFO in liaising with external partners, including auditors and banks, coordinating information requests and ensuring timely follow-up. 

- Communicate financial insights clearly to non-financial colleagues and support adoption of new reporting tools and processes. 

Requirements 

Work experience 

- Holds a degree in Finance (Diploma, Master’s, or higher), preferably complemented by a professional accounting qualification (ACCA, ACA, CIMA or equivalent).

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization to join our Billing team in the Amsterdam office. About the role:

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on the systems this team owns: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. As we move from seats to usage and credits for our agentic products, these systems become as strategic as the product itself, and they have to be fast, accurate and trustworthy.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who cares about correctness as much as speed, and wants to see the commercial impact of their code.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
description:
About Stream 

Stream powers real-time Chat , Video , Activity Feeds , and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role 

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on 

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities: 

- Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

- Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

- Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

- Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

- Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

- Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you 

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have: 

- Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

- Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

- A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

- Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

- Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

- Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

- Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points: 

- Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

- Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

- Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

- CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

- Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

- Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

- Python or Rust alongside Go

- Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting 

- Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

- Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

- Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

- Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream? 

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer 

- Company equity

- 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

- Pension plan with a company contribution

- NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

- Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

- Catered lunches in the office

- MacBook Pro

- Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

- Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture 

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

Stream is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

Hybrid office policy: applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

description:

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

How you'll make impact

You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech.

- Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility.

- Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon.

- Translate complex technology risk into clear recommendations for engineers, senior executives, and board-level risk committees, drawing on frameworks and expectations including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, DORA, MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials 

- 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity.

- Big Four background.

- Experience building and testing risk controls.

- A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams.

- Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures.

- Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security.

- Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling.

- Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity.

- Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners.

- Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Preferred 

- Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines.

- Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company.

- People management experience.

- Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

- Experience integrating GRC platforms, BI dashboards such as Tableau or Looker, and continuous compliance monitoring tools.

- Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications.

You'll thrive here if

- You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

- You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

Learn more about your team

Risk is part of Regulatory & Compliance at Airwallex.

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

description:

About SkinVision

If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

What will you be doing? 

- Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market, mainly focusing on the Belgian market;

- Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

- Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

- Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

- Customer-centric mindset;

- You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

What we offer

- 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

- An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing. 

- A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use. 

- Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office. 

- Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

- Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

- Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

- A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

Interview Process 

- Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual 

- Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual

- Final Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

- Values Interview - 30mins IRL

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

The role

What you will do

What you bring

- Entrepreneurial mindset: you want to build a company, not just a product – full ownership, bias for action and comfort with ambiguity

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Turn new revenue opportunities into products construction companies pay for. 

Your mission

Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area.

What you'll do

- Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.

- Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.

- Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.

- Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.

After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.

How we work

- Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.

- Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly.

- Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.

- AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?

What you bring

- 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on

- You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for

- You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work

- You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so

- You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management

- German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English

- Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or with construction or another industry that is just going digital.

Why us?

- Real impact: You own a growth opportunity, with short decision paths to our Head of Product, and you see the result in our numbers.

- A head start: Your first opportunity is prepared for you, so you can get going from day one.

- Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

- Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Europe, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

- Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

- A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

- Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

- Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role 

We’re looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Senior Partner Manager (Strategic Partnerships) to build and scale Perk’s partner ecosystem across Europe, with a particular focus on the DACH region.

This is a commercial role with a clear objective: build partnerships that generate qualified sales pipeline and revenue for Perk. You’ll identify and recruit the right partners, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and turn those relationships into a repeatable growth channel. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing while owning partner relationships from initial outreach through launch, activation, and ongoing performance.

The ideal person combines a builder’s mindset with strong commercial instincts. You’re comfortable opening doors, creating something from scratch, and earning the trust of senior stakeholders. You’re ambitious, persistent, and focused on measurable results.

What You’ll Do 

- Build our partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential referral, reseller, technology, and strategic alliance partners across Europe, with a particular focus on DACH.

- Generate pipeline and revenue: Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, turning partnerships into a meaningful and repeatable growth channel for Perk.

- Create joint go-to-market strategies: Build plans with priority partners across target accounts, campaigns, events, referrals, and co-selling motions.

- Own the commercial relationship: Lead partner conversations from initial outreach through business case development, negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing growth.

- Activate and enable partners: Give partners the product knowledge, sales materials, training, and support they need to confidently position Perk and identify opportunities.

- Partner closely with Sales and Marketing: Ensure partner-generated opportunities are effectively routed, prioritised, and converted, while creating scalable ways for our commercial teams to work with partners.

- Measure and improve performance: Set targets, forecast partner pipeline and revenue, identify what’s working, and continuously improve our partnership strategy and playbooks.

- Bring new opportunities to Perk: Stay close to market and product developments and identify new partner models that can accelerate growth or create meaningful value for our customers.

What We’re Looking For 

- Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

- Track record: Proven success in partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or business development, ideally within SaaS, fintech, travel technology, or another B2B technology environment.

- ERP and finance technology ecosystem : Hands on experience working with ERP, accounting and finance automation vendors and their partner ecosystems (e.g Netsuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, Xero, Datev).

- Commercial performance: A history of building partnerships that generate measurable sales pipeline and revenue against targets.

- Builder mentality: Comfortable developing new partner relationships and go-to-market motions from scratch rather than simply managing an established programme.

- Executive presence: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to build relationships and negotiate with senior and C-level stakeholders.

- Commercial judgment: Able to assess which opportunities are worth pursuing, structure mutually valuable partnerships, and focus time on the relationships most likely to produce meaningful results.

- Cross-functional mindset: A low-ego, team-first approach and the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other teams.

- Ownership: Independent, ambitious, persistent, and comfortable being accountable for outcomes.

- Based within commuting distance of our hub.

- Travel: Willingness to travel regularly across Europe for partner meetings, conferences and events.

What we offer 

- 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

- Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

- Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

- Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

- Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

- Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

- 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

- 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

- Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

- A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

- Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process 

- Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

- Hiring Manager Interview - 30mins Virtual

- Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

- Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

- Erfahrung in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics oder Marketing Technology , mit praktischer Verantwortung für Website-Tracking.

- Verständnis für Attribution, Cookies und Consent Management , einschließlich der Grenzen des Trackings über Sessions und Geräte hinweg.

- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse ; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Nice to Have 

- SQL-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Website-Event-Daten in BigQuery, Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Plattformen.

title: Customer Success Lead
description:
Über BringLiesel

BringLiesel ist die Plattform für individuelle Bewohnerversorgung in der stationären Pfege. Über 1.200 Produkte des täglichen Bedarfs werden online bestellt, einzeln je Bewohner:in verpackt und revisionssicher abgerechnet. Unsere Prozesse sind dabei tief in den Alltag der Pfege und Betreuung integriert. Über 2.300 Einrichtungen und mehr als 80.000 Pfegebedürftige vertrauen uns bereits. Unser Anspruch: Selbstbestimmung für Bewohner:innen. Entlastung für Pfege und Verwaltung. Efzienz für den Träger.

Deine Rolle

Wir befnden uns in einer Wachstumsphase – und diese Rolle ist ihr Motor im Bestand: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Customer-Success-Prozess von BringLiesel, von der erfolgreichen Anbindung neuer Einrichtungen bis zu ihrem nachhaltigen Ausbau. Du brauchst dafür beides – eine ausgeprägte Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität für das operative Tagesgeschäft und den strategischen Weitblick, um die Rolle neu zu defnieren und BringLiesel für die Zukunft aufzustellen. Du holst dein Team operativ ab, führst es strategisch und setzt die richtigen Initiativen. Dabei führst du drei Account Manager, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.

Deine Aufgaben

- Vom Onboarding bis zum Ausbau: Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Einrichtungen – von der Anbindung über die Etablierung im Pfegealltag bis zum kontinuierlichen Ausbau.
- Wachstum im Bestand: Du stärkst die Durchdringung in den Einrichtungen (mehr Bewohnende pro Einrichtung), baust die Warenkörbe aus und etablierst BringLiesel fest im Alltag der Einrichtung.
- Führung & Entwicklung: Fachliche und persönliche Führung von drei Account Managern, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.
- Zusammenspiel mit Marketing: Enge, gestaltende Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing und Digital Customer Experience als zentraler Wachstumshebel.
- Strategische Weiterentwicklung: Du defnierst die Rolle neu, setzt die richtigen Initiativen und Prozesse und stellst den Bereich zukunftsfest auf.
- Steuerung über Kennzahlen: Du machst Durchdringung, Warenkorb und Kundenbindung messbar und sorgst dafür, dass die Kennzahlen auch wirken.
Dein Profil

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account- oder Bestandskundenmanagement, idealerweise mit Führungsverantwortung.
- Du denkst und handelst strategisch UND operativ – mit klarer Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität.
- Nachweisbare Erfolge im Ausbau von Bestandskunden (Durchdringung, Upsell, Warenkorb) –gerne datengetrieben.
- Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing.
- Führungskompetenz: Du entwickelst ein kleines Team und gehst als Vorbild voran.
- Kommunikationsstark und empathisch – gerade im sensiblen Pfegeumfeld wichtig.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Was wir bieten

- Die Chance, den Customer Success bei BringLiesel neu zu defnieren und für die Zukunftaufzustellen – eine Rolle, die du von Anfang an prägst.
- Führungsverantwortung für ein dreiköpfges Account-Management-Team.
- Viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Wachstumsphase: BringLiesel wächst, und diese Rolle wächst mit.
- Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du trägst direkt dazu bei, dass Pfegebedürftige selbstbestimmt einkaufen können.
- Standort wahlweise Lübeck oder Hamburg – mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Kontakt zu allen Teams.

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role: 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits: 

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

- A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

- A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

- 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

- A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

- Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

- Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

- Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

- The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

- A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. 

Responsibilities: 

In this role, you will:

- Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.

- Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

- Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.

- Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.

- Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.

- Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.

- Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

Your Profile: 

- 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.

- A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.

- Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.

- Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

- Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.

- Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.

- A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.

- Fluent English required 

Our hiring process :

- TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.

- Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager.

- Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️
It varies from 1 to 3 interviews 

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs 

Ready to apply? 

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English. 
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role. 

#LI-PM1

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role: 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

- A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

- A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

- 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

- A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

- Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

- Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

- Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

- The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

- A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. 

Responsibilities: 

In this role, you will:

- Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.

- Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

- Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.

- Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.

- Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.

- Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.

- Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.

- Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

- A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.

- Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

- Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.

- Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.

- A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns: 

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung: 

- Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

- Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

- Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

- Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

- Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

- Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

- Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

🧠 Das bringst du mit: 

- In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“

- Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner.

- Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern.
