We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

Your team

You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.

Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.

Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

Who we are looking for

Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.

Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.

Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.

Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.

Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.

AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.

Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding): 

- You deeply understand trawa's business and product

- You have established your philosophy of running Product & Tech teams’ delivery

- You shape new quarterly roadmap and OKR plans for your teams

Month 3 (Ramp-Up): 

- You have assembled the company around your product vision for the entire customer journey

- Your vision for the customer journey comes to live - first key metrics are moved

- Your teams follow your rhythm of value delivery in fast measurable iterations

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: This is a rare opportunity to own product end-to-end at a company where product is the business. You won't be managing a feature backlog — you'll be shaping a platform that spans energy trading, real-time asset steering, and enterprise software. Few product roles in Europe offer this combination of complexity, commercial impact, and speed.

Responsibility & Support: You'll join the leadership team with direct impact on company strategy. We support you through regular leadership sessions, cross-department leadership initiatives, and experienced mentors who want to see you succeed.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

title: Senior Hardware Engineer - Drone Port (m/f/d)
description:
At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port enables our UAV platforms to launch, land, charge and return to mission readiness autonomously.

As a Senior Hardware Engineer, you will be the technical point of contact for core hardware topics across the Drone Port product. You will guide hardware development from concept and prototypes through verification and validation, supporting the product lifecycle through series readiness and customer demonstrations.

You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, Embedded Software, Systems Engineering, Testing, Manufacturing, Procurement and external development partners and suppliers. Your work will help deliver reliable, available and manufacturable hardware for current and future Drone Port generations.

What is your Day to Day Mission: 

- Act as the technical point of contact for key hardware topics across the Drone Port product.

- Develop and assess hardware concepts for future Drone Port generations, and support architecture and design decisions.

- Guide the hardware development lifecycle from concept through prototypes, technical verification and system validation.

- Contribute to PCB, wiring harness and system designs with internal teams and external development partners.

- Plan, build and commission hardware prototypes, and support integration, testing and customer demonstrations.

- Provide technical leadership to the hardware and electronics development team, and technical support to the Drone Port Testing team.

- Support Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering and Manufacturing with hardware expertise.

- Own hardware bills of materials, component availability and technical documentation, keeping records accurate and current.

- Coordinate technical orders and manage hardware inventory and development materials incl. in-house workshop management. 

- Work with Procurement, Manufacturing and suppliers to ensure hardware is available when development milestones require it.

- Prepare hardware procurement decisions in line with defined budgets and development needs.

- Deliver hardware solutions on time and meet product quality and reliability goals.

- Continuously improve the hardware architecture for robustness, maintainability and manufacturability, and support the technical development of future Drone Port generations.

What you bring to the team: 

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable discipline.

- Several years of professional experience developing technical systems and designing hardware.

- Strong CAD skills; familiarity with CATIA V5 is an advantage.

- Experience building and testing electronic and mechanical prototypes.

- Experience industrialising prototypes and transitioning them into series production.

- Experience working with bills of materials, component management and suppliers.

- A structured, self-directed and solution-oriented approach to work.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Knowledge of German is an advantage.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 

Why Quantum-Systems: 

- We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

- We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. 

- We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

- We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits: 

- Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

- Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

- Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

- Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

- Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

- Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

- Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

- Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

- Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

title: Sales Director DACH
description:
We’re looking for an experienced regional sales leader who combines strategic thinking with a strong hands-on approach — someone with a proven track record in scaling revenue in high-growth environments, preferably in cybersecurity or software, who can lead and develop a regional sales team, drive new business and expansion, build and manage a strong pipeline, work closely with channel partners, and ensure disciplined sales execution to consistently deliver predictable growth and exceed revenue targets. If you feel energized by fast pace, big ambitions and want to build something meaningful in the security domain — you’ll find a strong fit at Exeon Analytics.

The Sales Director DACH will play a key leadership role in developing and executing the regional sales strategy to accelerate growth and expand our presence across the Enterprise Market and Mid-Market segments in the DACH region. This role requires a strong understanding of complex enterprise sales and procurement processes, excellent relationship building skills, and the ability to translate strategy into consistent sales execution. You will lead and develop a team of sales professionals while driving revenue growth, customer acquisition, and increase market share across the region.

As a DACH Sales Director of Sales, you will be a core member of our Commercial Leadership Team and thus closely collaborate with the Channel and Marketing teams. You will contribute to and execute the go-to-market & revenue growth strategy for Exeon Analytics in the DACH region and work closely with leadership.

This is a high-impact role: your hunter attitude (creating win-win situations with our customers, activate networks, develop relationships) paired with methodological discipline (process, metrics, playbooks) plus your hunger to roll up sleeves, build pipeline, and drive predictable revenue growth will enable success.

Key responsibilities: 

- Build, manage and coach a high-performing team in the DACH region: direct reports include enterprise and mid-market account executives. Cultivate performance-driven sales culture: high drive, accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, hands-on execution.

- Forecast revenue, manage pipeline health, report to the Chief Revenue Officer; deliver against growth targets and scale-up metrics (CAC, sales cycle length, renewal/expansion).

- Own full sales cycle for key target accounts in the region: personally engage in large enterprise / strategic deals, drive negotiations, close major contracts.

- Apply sales methodologies and process, build sales-enablement and data-driven insights: value-maps, customer case-studies, competitive positioning; use analytics to optimise win-rates, conversion, sales velocity.

- Opportunity management and development: support the regional sales team in driving complex sales opportunities from qualification through close, navigating procurement processes including RFPs and RFQs while effectively managing key stakeholders and commercial requirements.

- Contract negotiation and execution: lead commercial and contract negotiations in collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring timely execution and a seamless transition from deal closure to customer onboarding.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: work with marketing (account-based marketing), channel (System Integrators, VAD, Resellers, MSSPs) and product (feedback & positioning).

- Actively support major and strategic deals through negotiation and closing, while building and maintaining strong relationships with sales leaders across our key regional partners.

- Stay abreast of cybersecurity & security analytics market trends, competitor landscape, regulatory/compliance drivers (e.g., NIS2, DORA) and use this knowledge to refine sales approach.

What makes a good person-job-fit: 

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic individual who’s comfortable in a high-paced scale-up environment and who shares our values. In addition, we are looking for certain requirements and skills to establish a good person-job-fit:

- Minimum 8 years in B2B enterprise software sales (preferably cybersecurity platform) with proven track record of scaling revenue throughout different growth phases, ideally scale-up experience.

- Experience in leading and building sales teams with hiring, training, mentoring and performance management. You build trust, coach your team, but also hold them accountable.

- Strong personal network of relevant enterprise customers, decision-makers, and industry stakeholders across the DACH market.

- Strong methodological sales orientation: experience implementing structured sales frameworks (MEDDPICC), setting KPIs, establishing process discipline and metrics. 

- Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities, experienced in developing and executing complex sales strategies, contract negotiation, and operational leadership. 

- Hands-on mentality: comfortable personally selling major deals, rolling up sleeves in a scale-up context. 

- Ability to work cross-functionally and influence peers, leaders and external partners. 

- High energy, resilience and competitive drive: you get motivated by growth, targets, building something meaningful. 

- Strong written and verbal communication in English and German. 

- Passion for cybersecurity and the culture of a fast-growing scale-up 

Education 

- Bachelor's Degree or MBA preferred

title: Senior Delivery Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Führende Unternehmen wie Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, BMW, Bosch und Rheinmetall setzen auf SPREADs Software, um ihren Ingenieur- und Expertenteams zu ermöglichen, die Komplexität softwaredefinierter Fahrzeuge und Produkte souverän zu beherrschen.
Unsere auf EE & SW spezialisierte Datenkontextualisierungs-Software verwandelt komplexe Produktdaten in leicht nutzbare Engineering Intelligence . Vorkonfigurierte Anwendungen und KI-Agenten helfen Teams, entscheidendes Produktwissen gezielt einzusetzen – so können Fahrzeuge und andere komplexe Produkte bis zu zehnmal schneller, zu halbierten Kosten und in besserer Qualität auf den Markt gebracht werden.
Das gelingt durch automatisierte Erkenntnisse, die bessere Produktentscheidungen und deren Umsetzung unterstützen und dafür sorgen, dass Zeit-, Qualitäts- und Budgetziele im gesamten Produktlebenszyklus konsequent erreicht oder übertroffen werden.
Für seine innovative Technologie hat SPREAD bereits zahlreiche Auszeichnungen erhalten, darunter den SPARK KI-Innovationspreis vom Handelsblatt & McKinsey 2024. Zudem ist SPREAD Teil der EU AI Champions Initiative und zählt zu den LinkedIn Top 20 Startups in DACH.

Deine Verantwortung

- End-to-End-Steuerung von SPREAD-Delivery-Projekten vom Sales-Handover bis Go-Live und Hypercare: Festlegung ambitionierter Ziele und Zeitpläne in Abstimmung mit vereinbarten Erfolgskriterien sowie Sicherstellung der Lieferung im definierten Leistungsumfang, innerhalb von Zeitplan und Budget.

- Sicherstellung der Delivery durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Engineering und Product Teams sowie Kunden-Teams um das Projekt ins Ziel zu bringen: von der Anbindung von Datenquellen über die Integration in unseren Engineering Intelligence Graph bis zur Konfiguration von Anwendungen in SPREAD Studio und dem Einsatz von KI Agenten zur Lösung konkreter Use Cases mit messbarem Mehrwert.

- Planung und Moderation technischer und explorativer Workshops sowie Steuerung von UAT , Cutover und Adoption für Zielgruppen, in Abstimmung mit den von Value Engineering definierten Zielen.

- Koordination funktionsübergreifender Workstreams und Steuerung von Risiken, Annahmen, Entscheidungen und Änderungen mit klaren Executive-Updates und Stakeholder-gerechter Kommunikation.

- Transparentes Tracking und Kommunikation intern und an unsere Kunden bzgl. des Delivery Status und Reife sowie Value-Trackings und Dokumentation.

- Systematische Rückführung von Erkenntnissen aus Kundenprojekten in die Produktentwicklung zur Verbesserung von Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Wiederverwendung über Kunden hinweg.

Deine Erfahrung

- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Durchführung oder Steuerung komplexer Enterprise-Software-Projekte , idealerweise in Engineering-intensiven Branchen wie Automotive, Aerospace, Defence oder Maschinenbau.

- Erfahrung in Projekten mit Anbindung heterogener IT-Systeme und Abbildung von Entitäten in ein einheitliches Datenmodell sowie Vertrautheit mit APIs und Sicherheitsanforderungen .

- Fähigkeit zur Durchführung strukturierter Workshops sowie klare schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation für technische Zielgruppen als auch für die Führungsebene.

- Souveräne Kommunikation intern und gegenüber Kunden, auch in kritischen Situationen und Eskalationen, mit gezielter Steuerung der Stakeholder und Sicherstellung aller Voraussetzungen fpr einen erfolgreichen Rollout (z.B. Datenkonnektoren).

- Ausgeprägte Ergebnisorientierung mit konsequenter Verknüpfung von Deliverables zu messbarem Wert sowie Steuerung aller Projektphasen anhand transparenter KPIs.

- Kollaborative, organisierte und hands-on Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, Erkenntnisse aus Projekten in standardisierte Komponenten und Rollout-Playbooks zu überführen.

- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Warum SPREAD?

- Innovationsführer : Unsere Agentic‑Engineering‑Intelligence‑Plattform verknüpft Hardware‑ und Software‑Daten zu dynamischen Produkt Zwillingen – darauf agieren KI‑Agenten, die Compliance‑Checks, Abhängigkeitsanalysen und Spezifikationsaufbereitung automatisieren. Das Ergebnis: 10× schnellere Time‑to‑Market und 50% geringere Lifecycle‑Kosten bei OEMs wie VW, Mercedes‑Benz und Rheinmetall. ;

- Relevanz für die Industrie : Sobald Produkte software‑definiert sind, stößt klassisches PLM an ihre Grenzen. Mit SPREAD führst du Hersteller in die Daten‑ und KI‑Ära – und eröffnest ihnen Einsparungen in Millionenhöhe.

- H. per‑Wachstum & Ownership : Seit 2019 jedes Jahr zweistelliges Wachstum; Neue Branchen & Regionen bieten Gestaltungsspielraum und Potenzial.

- Starkes Gesamtpaket : Attraktives OTE, Mobilitätsbudget (Deutschlandticket), Urban‑Sports‑Partnerschaft, 30 Urlaubstage, Workation‑Optionen, Volunteering‑Day und 1.000 € Learning‑Budget.

- Sicherheit & Flexibilität : ISO 27001 / TISAX zertifiziert, DSGVO‑konform, Deployments in Cloud oder On‑Premises – und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das sich deinem Leben anpasst.

title: Head of Marketing & Growth (w/m/d)
description:
Über STUR

Wir sind das Berliner Startup STUR: Wir entwickeln zeitlose, langlebige und nachhaltige Designprodukte für die Küche. Alles Made in Germany - unsere Gusseisenpfannen sind preisgekrönt. Wir möchten Foodies wie dich zu neuen kulinarischen Entdeckungen inspirieren und die Profiküche zu dir nach Hause bringen.

Wir haben ein funktionierendes, profitables Geschäftsmodell, wachsen dynamisch und wollen bis 2030 in einer Million Küchen zu finden sein. Um das zu erreichen, denken wir Performance Marketing und Branding aus einem Guss. Und hierfür suchen wir nun dich als

Head of Marketing & Growth (w/m/d). 

(deutschsprachig, ab sofort, hybrid in Berlin oder remote). 

Deine Aufgaben

- Verantwortung für Umsatz und Marketingeffizienz : Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unser zukünftiges Wachstum und die weitere Profitabilität unserer Marke. Hierzu gehört es, STUR weiter emotional als High-End-Brand zu positionieren sowie die gesamte Klaviatur der Performance-Kanäle abzudecken.

- Strategie : Zusammen mit unseren Co-Foundern entwickelst du die Marketingstrategie weiter und arbeitest an der kontinuierlichen Umsetzung. Du entwickelst und etablierst Prozesse und Strukturen, die weiteres Wachstum ermöglichen.

- Leadership : Du leitest ein dreiköpfiges Team und baust es langfristig weiter aus. Dabei führst du auf Augenhöhe und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung deiner Teammitglieder.

- Hands-on-Umsetzung : Zusammen mit deinem Team sowie Agenturen und Freelancer*innen setzt du die Strategie in Kampagnen um (aktuell v.a. Meta Ads, Google Ads, CRM und Influencer). Du steuerst das Testing und optimierst laufend unsere Conversion-Rate.

- Datenbasierte Entscheidungen : Du triffst deine Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten, entwickelst Reporting- und KPI-Strukturen weiter und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

Dein Profil

- Du besitzt mehrjährige fundierte Berufserfahrung im Onlinemarketing in stark wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen und hast ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der Full-Funnel-Steuerung.

- Du hast Erfahrung im Aufbau einer Premium-D2C-Marke, die hohe AOVs erzielt, und dabei eine Umsatzverantwortung im mindestens achtstelligen Bereich gehabt.

- Du hast bereits Teams aufgebaut, geführt und langfristig weiterentwickelt. Gleichzeitig hast du Lust, Kampagnen in den gängigen Paid- und Organic-Channels hands-on selbst zu steuern.

- Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Creatives als zentraler Performance-Hebel. Mit deiner Kreativität und deinem Markenverständnis entwickelst du STUR langfristig zur Love-Brand.

- Du hast Spaß an der Analyse von Daten, arbeitest mit Attributionstools und kennst deren Grenzen. Mit Tools wie Klar bist du vertraut.

- Du besitzt eine große Passion für moderne Küche, kochst gern und kannst dich mit unseren ikonischen, nachhaltigen und funktionalen Made-in-Germany-Produkten identifizieren.

- Dein Deutsch ist fließend in Wort und Schrift, dein Englisch ist konversationssicher.

Deine Benefits

- Ownership und Perspektive: In dieser Rolle hast du die volle Verantwortung für die dynamische Weiterentwicklung einer erfolgreichen D2C-Cookware-Brand, die etablierte Premiummarken herausfordert.

- Faire Vergütung und beste Bedingungen: Apple Hardware, 30 Urlaubstage, festes Weiterbildungsbudget zur freien Verfügung.

- Flexibilität: familientaugliche Arbeitszeiten, Vertrauensarbeitszeit, Homeoffice. Die Stelle kann zu 100 % remote ausgeübt werden, wir wünschen uns regelmäßige persönliche Treffen in Berlin.

- Viele Extras: Deutschlandticket, bezuschusste Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, Corporate Benefits, täglich leckeres Essen im Office und natürlich kulinarische Team-Events.

title: Head of Product & Technology (m/f/d)
description:
About enua

enua is an integrated medical cannabis company with a mission to give patients safe and reliable access to treatment. We are the second-largest supplier in the German market and a fast-growing international group, on track for around €100m in group revenue in 2026 with a double-digit EBITDA margin. Founded in Cologne in 2018, we have built a profitable business across our own products and more than 700 partner pharmacies.

Now we are bringing that to the UK. Medical cannabis is one of the fastest-growing areas of UK healthcare: around 140,000 people will be prescribed it in 2026, up from around 100,000 a year earlier. Yet an estimated 1.8 million people in the UK already use cannabis to manage a health condition, mostly outside the legal system. That is more than 10x today’s market, in a category that is still largely uncharted.

We are building a clinic and platform that makes care simpler, faster and more personal. Our UK team is at an early stage, which means real ownership, real impact and the chance to shape how we work from day one.

The role

- Location: London, 4 days a week in the office
- Reporting to: MD and Co-Founder UK
- Employment type: Full-time, permanent
As Head of Product & Technology, you will own the platform at the heart of enua UK: the patient-facing product and the systems behind it, from first visit through consultation, prescription and repeat order. We want patients to genuinely love using us, and this role is central to making that happen. It is a founding leadership role and one of the most important hires we will make.

You will not start from a blank page: we have already built a modern, AI-native platform. You will take it forward: setting the strategy for how it evolves, making the big build, buy and partner calls, and shipping the features that make us the easiest and most trusted way for UK patients to access care. You will be hands-on from day one, sit on our management team alongside our MD and Co-Founder, and work closely with our group technology team.

Tasks

- Platform strategy: Set the strategy for our UK platform so it gives us a lasting advantage through convenience, quality and cost. Build on the foundations we have and decide where we build, buy or partner across EHR, telehealth, pharmacy, payments and CRM.
- Leadership: Be a core member of our management team, jointly responsible for the strategy and execution of the business. Build and lead a high-performing product and engineering function as we scale, working closely with group colleagues.
- Patient experience: Own the end-to-end patient product, from first visit to repeat order, and drive exceptional patient satisfaction. Set the roadmap with the MD and management team, balancing the needs of patients, clinicians and operations.
- Hands-on build: Build and ship yourself. Balance pace with reliability, keep technical debt in check, and set high standards for architecture, security and AI-assisted code.
- Testing, data and analytics: Own end-to-end testing and optimisation, from UX to back end, and the tracking, analytics and reporting the business runs on.
- AI agenda: Set the AI agenda for the organisation, finding where it can improve the patient experience and how we work, and making sure it is used safely.
- Compliance and clinical safety: Make sure our platform meets the standards of a regulated healthcare provider, including CQC, UK GDPR and clinical safety (DCB0129/DCB0160), working with our group quality and regulatory teams.
Requirements

- A product leader: 7+ years in product and technology, with at least 3 leading a product or engineering function. Obsessed with patient experience, with strong UX instincts and the ability to turn patient and commercial needs into a clear roadmap. You have hired and led teams and been part of a management team.
- Technically deep: Strong architectural judgement, able to set technical direction, review code (including AI-generated code) and build data and analytics the business can rely on.
- A builder: You have taken a digital product from 0 to 1 and on through rapid scale, ideally in D2C subscription, telehealth or digital health.
- Regulation-ready: Experience delivering in a regulated environment (healthcare, pharma, fintech or similar), and comfortable with data protection, security and clinical safety.
- Commercially sharp: You make smart build, buy and partner decisions with an eye on total cost and speed.
- Hands-on and AI-first: You still enjoy building and shipping yourself, and use AI to move faster and do more.
Benefits

- Define a new category: Medical cannabis is still young in the UK. You will build the platform that sets the standard for how patients access care.
- Build it with the founding team: A seat on our small management team from day one, working side by side with our MD and Co-Founder.
- Real ownership: Own the platform, the roadmap and the technology choices, with the mandate to build the team and partner ecosystem to deliver them.
- A fast-growing market: Patient numbers are growing by around 40% a year, with more than 10x headroom still to come.
- Work that matters: What you build will make it easier for people with long-term conditions to get treatment that works for them.
- Serious backing: The support of a profitable European healthcare group with real credentials in products, pharmacy and telemedicine.
We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Excited but not sure you tick every box? We would still love to hear from you. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, just let us know.

description:

Our teams are putting the world's retailers online using cloud technology, robotics, AI and automation. Through the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP), we provide innovative technology and operational services to partners globally, supporting highly automated fulfilment centres and world-class online grocery operations.

As our global footprint expands, we are continuously investing in robust health, safety, fire and environmental management to ensure a safe, compliant and high-performing working environment. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in embedding a strong safety culture across our international operational services.

About the Role 

We are looking for a Senior HSFE Specialist to join our Operational Services team based in Hatfield (with travel) , reporting directly to the Operational Resilience Director .

In this role, you will play a key part in establishing and driving Health, Safety, Fire, and Environmental (HSFE) compliance across our sites globally, embedding a proactive safety culture and ensuring consistent adherence to first-line requirements. Working closely with the HSFE Lead and operational leadership teams, you will provide day-to-day practical guidance and take ownership of delivering key first-line activities to support continuous improvement in safety standards across our operations.

The role involves travel across our UK CFCs, with potential international travel to our global sites when operational needs arise.

What You'll Be Doing 

- Design for Future: 

- Support the design and continuous improvement of the HSFE Management System.

- Help build a proactive safety culture across sites through engaging communication, training initiatives, and site-level engagement.

- Work with operational teams to identify emerging risks, compliance gaps, and design mitigation plans ahead of need.

- Contribute to the design of the annual audit and inspection schedule.

- Support the development of H&S KPIs, operational metrics, and emergency preparedness activities.

- Deliver for Today: 

- Support site inspections, audits, and risk assessments through the timely management and resolution of identified actions.

- Support investigations into accidents, incidents, and near-misses, identifying root causes and driving corrective actions.

You are an organized, proactive, and solutions-focused safety professional who can build instant credibility and influence at all levels of an operation. You possess meticulous attention to detail, stay calm under pressure, and take a practical approach to resolving safety issues through sound, risk-based judgements.

- Solid understanding of UK health and safety legislation and its practical application within an operational environment (knowledge of international H&S legislation is a strong plus).

title: Senior Growth Director (Commercial Lead)
description:
About Moloco: 

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture) , the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next. 

The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco: 

Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Director and lead the strategic growth of some of our most important partners across EMEA. As a senior individual contributor, you will own a dedicated portfolio of top accounts, building executive partnerships and developing commercial strategies that create lasting value for customers and Moloco.

You will bring a deep understanding of each customer’s business, connect their priorities to Moloco’s capabilities, and lead our most complex commercial conversations. Your impact will extend beyond your own portfolio through selective support on high-stakes opportunities, coaching, and influencing Moloco’s product and commercial direction.

The Opportunity: 

Based in London, you’ll operate as a Commercial Lead within the EMEA Growth team, accountable for substantial revenue outcomes and long-term customer growth. This is an individual contributor role combining hands-on account ownership with commercial leadership across the wider team.

Strategic Growth & Commercial Ownership 

- Own and deliver revenue targets across a dedicated portfolio of top EMEA accounts, with accountability for forecast accuracy, risk management, and long-term growth.

- Set and drive the multi-year growth agenda for your customers, leading joint business planning with executive stakeholders to secure investment commitments, establish shared accountability, and drive delivery against ambitious commercial goals.

- Unlock incremental revenue through expansion into new geographies, business units, use cases, and product adoption.

- Own the most complex and ambiguous commercial negotiations across your portfolio, structuring non-standard agreements in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and leadership to balance customer value, commercial risk, and sustainable growth.

Consultative Selling & Executive Partnership 

- Act as a trusted commercial advisor and industry expert to your customers, combining deep knowledge of their business models and company goals with insight into market dynamics and competitive trends to challenge assumptions, shape growth strategies, and identify where Moloco can create lasting business value.

- Develop tailored proposals grounded in customer business outcomes, including lifetime value, payback period, and return on ad spend at scale.

- Build long-term strategic partnerships with customers, independently owning C-suite and senior commercial relationships and aligning Moloco’s role in their growth with shared objectives, investment priorities, and measures of success.

- Use trusted executive relationships to shape customer priorities, influence investment decisions, and unlock growth opportunities beyond existing campaigns—including opening doors to new decision-makers, business units, and markets.

- Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning conversations, translating performance data into clear recommendations for long-term growth.

Product Expertise & Cross-Functional Influence 

- Apply deep knowledge of Moloco’s products, machine learning capabilities, and the mobile advertising ecosystem to shape credible solutions for customers.

- Work hands-on with data to test growth hypotheses, diagnose challenges, and build commercially sound recommendations.

- Act as the voice of the market, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to translate customer needs, industry trends, and competitive insights into recommendations that shape product priorities and unlock growth.

- Lead the commercial development of new and ambiguous growth opportunities, setting direction, mobilising cross-functional teams, and driving customer validation to turn successful approaches into repeatable revenue opportunities across EMEA.

- Influence senior cross-functional stakeholders to prioritise strategic account opportunities, secure resources, and resolve competing priorities to deliver commercial outcomes.

Coaching & Commercial Leadership 

- Set the standard for consultative selling, deal strategy, negotiation, and executive engagement across EMEA, leading by example in your own accounts and coaching Growth Managers and Growth Directors to strengthen their commercial capabilities.

- Bring senior commercial expertise to accounts beyond your own portfolio, working alongside account owners to lead high-stakes customer conversations, navigate complex negotiations, and resolve escalations.

- Turn successful approaches into practical frameworks and playbooks that raise commercial standards across EMEA.

- Build a reputation as a recognised industry expert in adtech and mobile growth, actively speaking at industry events and sharing insights that strengthen Moloco’s credibility with customers and the wider market.

- Adapt your leadership and communication style to the audience and situation, using expertise and sound judgment to build trust, navigate disagreement, and secure commitment to action without formal management authority.

How Do I Know if the Role Is Right for Me? 

Experience & Expertise 

- 10+ years of experience in mobile advertising, account management, consultative sales, or commercial leadership.

- A proven track record of owning and growing some of an organisation’s largest and most strategically important accounts, navigating complex customer relationships and delivering substantial, sustained revenue growth.

- Experience leading complex commercial negotiations and structuring agreements around customer business objectives.

- Demonstrated ability to build trusted executive relationships and influence strategic investment decisions.

- Deep understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, mobile measurement partners (MMPs), attribution, and programmatic performance marketing.

- Evidence of improving commercial outcomes beyond your own accounts through coaching, co-selling, or cross-functional leadership.

- Fluency in English (Turkish a strong plus).

Skills & Mindset 

- Exceptional commercial judgment and the ability to understand how customers make money, assess opportunities, and make disciplined trade-offs.

- Strong product and analytical fluency, with the ability to connect technical capabilities and performance data to business value.

- Executive presence and clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex issues for senior audiences.

- High ownership and resilience, with the ability to sustain momentum through long commercial cycles and changing priorities.

- Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguous situations, creating clarity and mobilizing others around a shared outcome.

- A collaborative, low-ego approach, with a commitment to learning, sharing credit, and developing others.

Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life: 

Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.

Moloco Values: 

- Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success. 

- Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible. 

- Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value. 

- Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.

description:

- Experience owning solutions from technical design and development through testing, deployment and support. 

- Solid software engineering foundations, including debugging, exception handling, reusable code and testing. 

- Experience with REST APIs, SQL/databases, JSON, Git and enterprise-system integration. 

- Ability to investigate complex problems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and work independently in distributed teams. 

- Based in the UK and willing to travel occasionally for client engagements, project workshops and internal collaboration. 

NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES 

- UiPath Advanced RPA Developer or equivalent certification; Automation Anywhere Advanced or Master RPA Professional certification. 

- Experience with Power Automate, Power Platform or other automation technologies. 

- Experience integrating with SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or similar enterprise applications. 

- Familiarity with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud and CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 

- Experience with intelligent document processing, such as UiPath Document Understanding or Azure Document Intelligence.

- Experience in consultancy, client-facing delivery or Agile teams. 

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys building reliable solutions and solving difficult problems. You can move confidently between UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python, take ownership with limited supervision, work directly with clients, write clear and maintainable code, and share knowledge with colleagues. You value delivery quality and practical outcomes over technology for its own sake. 

WHAT WE OFFER 

- A UK-based remote role, with opportunities to collaborate with international delivery teams and clients. 

- The opportunity to work across multiple leading automation platforms rather than being restricted to one technology. 

- Exposure to emerging AI and Agentic Automation capabilities as our offering evolves. 

- A collaborative specialist consultancy environment that values initiative, technical expertise and practical problem-solving. 

- Opportunities to broaden your technical skills and contribute to the development of our automation practice.

- Strong knowledge of UK employment law and HR practices, with the ability to translate requirements into practical guidance for employees and managers.

- Significant hands-on employee relations experience, including managing complex or sensitive employee matters.

- Experience independently managing complex HR processes with strong attention to accuracy and compliance.

You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). We’re excited about you because…

- Experience with AWS, especially with networking primitives like LBs, Privatelink, etc. and Kubernetes or other container management tool

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling like Terraform

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash’s current and future products.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a Principal Researcher to be a strategic research leader for EMEA, shaping what DoorDash builds next. You’ll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You’ll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You’ll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.

What You’ll Be Doing

Shape Product Strategy: Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You’ll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.

Detect New Opportunities: Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You’ll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.

Lead Mixed-Methods Research: Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You’ll triangulate across sources so the “what,” the “how much,” and the “why” tell one coherent story.

Partner with Data Science and Experimentation: Work closely with data science and analytics to connect qualitative insight to A/B test design, metrics, and product outcomes, and to explain the “why” behind results. You’ll help teams learn from what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next.

Apply AI to the Research Craft: Use AI tools and LLMs in your daily workflow for synthesis, analysis, survey and discussion guide design, and scaling qualitative depth, and design human-in-the-loop checks that catch confident but wrong outputs. You’ll help the team identify where AI accelerates research and where it should not be trusted, and contribute to shared prompts, workflows, and standards. You’ll also study how people experience AI-powered features across DoorDash’s products.

Influence and Communicate: Tell compelling, decision-ready stories that move partners from insight to action. You’ll adapt depth and format to the moment, from a fast directional read that unblocks a team this week to a foundational body of work that anchors a multi-year strategy, and you’ll follow through to see that findings change what gets built.

Lead Through Others: Serve as a thought partner and mentor to researchers across levels, review and elevate research quality, and help partners run good research on their own where that makes sense. You’ll help set the team’s research agenda, methods, and standards, and contribute to hiring and growing the team.

Operate Across Brands and Regions: Bring a global lens to your work, partnering across brands, markets, and cultures and adapting approaches to local context so that insights scale beyond a single market.

- 10+ years of experience in user, market, or product research at a technology company (or equivalent depth), with a track record of leading ambiguous, high-visibility work at staff level or above

- Demonstrated impact on product strategy: examples where your research changed a roadmap, unlocked a new product or line of business, or redirected significant investment

- Expert command of both qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, ethnography, and usability testing as well as survey design, statistical analysis, and experimentation. Working knowledge of SQL, R, or Python for pulling and analyzing your own data is a plus

- Hands-on experience using AI and LLMs in research (for example, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, or scaling qualitative work), with sound instincts about where they help and where they mislead. Experience researching AI-powered products is a plus

- Experience in consumer, two-sided or multi-sided marketplace, logistics, commerce, or local services contexts is a plus

- A bias for speed and pragmatism: comfortable delivering directional insight quickly while knowing when a decision calls for deeper rigor

description:
Our Mission:

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

About the role

- Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked.

- The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet.

- A small team that ships fast . We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user.

What you’ll do

- Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on

- Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying

- Engineer how we feed context to AI models : how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention

- Evolve our workflow builder : something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections

- Design the architecture behind the product : how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.

Who you are

- You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath.

- You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.

- You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t.

- You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states.

- You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API.

title: Director of Engineering - Risk and Compliance
description:
Company Description 

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 

Role overview | Context 

Checkout.com built its name serving the world's largest enterprises. We're now growing into many more types of customer: businesses of every size, including self-serve, startups integrating straight from our docs, and platforms (software companies, payfacs and marketplaces) that onboard thousands of sellers through our APIs. As our product range grows, that takes us from thousands of customers to millions.

At that scale, the decision about who we work with, and on what terms, can't be a manual review at the end of a sales process. It has to be a product. It decides how quickly a good business goes live, how much it costs us to serve them, and how confident our regulators and scheme partners are in us. We're looking for a senior Engineering leader to own that decision.

This team decides which businesses we can work with and on what terms. It covers business verification, screening, underwriting, ongoing monitoring and financial crime. It's a shared platform that serves every one of our businesses. Its users are our customers (directly, or through the platforms they sign up with) and, internally, our Risk, Compliance and Financial Crime teams and the analysts who run reviews and investigations.

Much of what we have today was built segment by segment and market by market, for a smaller number of large customers. The next chapter is one opinionated, configurable decisioning platform. Enterprise, platform and SMB customers should all run on the same foundations, with the right depth of checks and the right terms for each. That way a new product, segment or market doesn't mean rebuilding our controls, and this team isn't on the critical path for every launch.

Role overview | Risk, Verification & Compliance 

The remit covers:

- Risk decisioning: underwriting, risk tiering, exposure limits, reserves and settlement terms, and when to restrict or offboard, re-assessed across the customer lifecycle.

- Business verification: company, ownership, document, bank account and website checks, run once for every segment.

- Financial crime: sanctions and PEP screening, AML and transaction monitoring, and the controls, audit trails and reporting behind our regulatory obligations.

- Decisioning platform: the shared infrastructure that runs these checks automatically for every market and customer type.

You'll partner closely with the teams that own onboarding and identity verification.

Role overview | Remit and Responsibilities 

You'll be comfortable building and scaling critical platforms in a regulated environment, where correctness, auditability and availability matter as much as speed. You'll balance two goals that are often in tension: making it fast and easy for good businesses to work with us, and keeping bad actors out and the business compliant.

This is a change role. You'll assess what we have, set a clear direction, and move us from segment-specific, analyst-led processes to an automated decisioning platform, without pausing the business while you do it. You'll do this in close partnership with Product, Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal, and with the leaders of the businesses that depend on the platform.

You'll directly lead an established team of engineers and managers of varying seniorities. Amongst other duties, you'll have impact across:

- Setting the technical vision and strategy for Risk, Verification & Compliance. That includes deciding what we build once and share, and what each segment, product or market configures.

- Building a decisioning platform that automates the decisions that don't need a human, safely, and sends the rest to the right analyst with the context they need. Our automation rate sets our cost to onboard and to serve.

- Making risk dynamic across the customer lifecycle. New businesses start on terms that match the signals we see: limits, reserves and settlement speed. Those terms relax automatically as the business trades well, and we act quickly when the signals change. This starts with simple rules and evolves into machine learning.

- Making decisions explainable, so that customers, partners and our own analysts understand why a decision was made and what happens next.

- Giving Risk and Compliance the dials. Acceptance criteria, early-life controls and policy should be configuration that can be changed, tested and measured by cohort, not a code change.

- Keeping our financial crime controls ahead of growth. Screening and monitoring have to scale from large enterprises to a very large base of smaller businesses, through new channels, payment methods and products.

- Leading the design and delivery of verification, screening, underwriting and monitoring systems that are accurate, auditable and highly available.

- Representing Engineering in regulatory, audit, scheme and partner conversations where needed.

- Managing and developing a high-performing team of individual contributor (IC) Engineers and Engineering Managers, providing guidance, support and career development.

- Striving for best practice on hiring, coaching and enablement, and being a magnet for top talent.

Role overview | Desired Background, Core Competencies 

The ideal candidate for the role will bring:

- Experience leading multi-level engineering organisations (EMs and ICs) through growth and change, with a track record of developing leaders, not just hiring them.

- A record of transforming critical platforms while the business kept running: multi-year re-architecture, migrations, or consolidating several systems into one.

- Experience building and operating mission-critical decisioning or rules platforms at scale. Ideally these served several customer segments, products or markets from a shared foundation.

- Experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or similar), where compliance, auditability and risk are part of the engineering problem.

- Deep technical understanding of cloud-native, distributed and data-heavy systems, including how to run ML models safely in production.

- Exceptional collaboration skills, with a proven ability to partner with senior cross-functional stakeholders, particularly in Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal, and to make clear trade-offs in a complex stakeholder landscape.

- Ideally, domain knowledge in KYB, AML and financial crime, underwriting, fraud or merchant risk. Experience with self-serve or high-volume onboarding, or with platforms and their sub-merchants, is a strong plus.

- Humility, low ego and an ideal ambassador for our mission, values and operating principles.

If you feel that you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please consider continuing in the process. We're always keen to build relationships with leaders who resonate with our mission and values.

Additional Information 

Bring all of you to work 

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com 

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering (Chromium)
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product 

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the rendering infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on loading modern web pages in a browser that we patch and build ourselves, so that content is rendered completely and reliably at a cost that works across billions of pages. You will work inside Chromium to remove what we do not need, make the rest faster and cheaper, and keep our build current as Chromium moves. Your work ensures that high-quality content is consistently available to the indexing and retrieval systems downstream.

In this position, your responsibility will be to 

- Change Chromium in its heavy core (Blink, the V8 integration, the compositor, the network service) to cut CPU, memory and startup cost per page

- Strip Chromium down for agent workloads: skip what nobody needs, such as image and media decoding, web font downloads, and rasterization and GPU work where no one needs pixels, while keeping what page scripts depend on to run correctly (style, layout, animation frames, observers), and work out what breaks, or renders differently, when you do

- Keep the browser compatible with the web: make sure that what we remove does not change how the sites we load behave or render

- Profile and tune fleets of browsers: the process model, memory per renderer, startup, isolation and crash handling

- Build the production system around it: how browsers are launched, pooled, recycled and monitored

You may be a good fit if you 

Have 5+ years of experience building production systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas.

Inside the browser 

- Strong C++ in a large, performance-critical codebase, ideally Chromium, Blink or V8, or a comparable browser engine (Rust is a plus)

- Chromium architecture: the process model, Mojo IPC, the rendering pipeline (DOM, style, layout, paint, compositing), and the network service

- Building, debugging and shipping custom Chromium builds: the build system, tracing, crash analysis, and maintaining patches across releases

Performance and systems 

- Profiling CPU, memory and I/O for browser fleets, with tools such as perf, tracing and flame graphs

- Linux process isolation and resource management, concurrency, and memory management

- Have run browsers in production, or built the infrastructure that does, and can describe where the time and memory went

Strong candidates may also have experience with 

- Contributions to Chromium, Blink, V8, Firefox, WebKit or another browser engine

- Building or maintaining a patched browser that you wrote the patches for

- Browser instrumentation, including the Chrome DevTools Protocol

- Working familiarity with how modern frontend frameworks render (SSR, CSR, streaming, hydration)

- Distributed systems, Kubernetes, and Go or Python

The kind of problems you will work on 

- Cut the cost of loading a page in half. Where do CPU and memory go, and what would you change in the browser?

- Turn off the GPU and image decoding for agent workloads. What breaks, and what changes in how pages load and render?

- A page runs a script that never yields. How do we detect and stop it without help from the page?

- Chromium ships a new version. How do we bring a large set of patches forward in days, not weeks?

- Decide when a page is finished, for pages with analytics beacons, long polling and endless scrolling.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Personal Assistant
description:
What we’re all about. 

We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The Opportunity 

Our part-time Leadership Personal Assistant (PA) to our Executive Committee will be a central point in enabling our Senior Leaders to focus on creating the biggest impact for our clients, our colleagues and our business strategy. This is for a fixed period of 6 months, role, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and you’ll be office based on all three days.

You’re a brilliant communicator, in writing and in person, with laser-focused attention to detail and a curious, intuitive, agile and practical approach to a busy, varied senior team. You’re a connector, seamlessly making things happen across Quantexa. What makes you Q will help you flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

Our 8 Senior Leaders head up our functions, and our CEO works with his own dedicated PA. You’ll start by supporting 4 of the Senior Leaders, working alongside our current PA. From January, you’ll provide maternity cover, looking after all 8 Senior Leaders until our PA returns from maternity leave in May. Support will be tailored to each leader, from regular day-to-day help to occasional, ad hoc requests.

Our Senior Leaders are used to being self-sufficient, so many of your duties will be cross-functional or project-focused. As you support them, we’ll support you. You’ll report to our Chief Operations Officer, who’ll help you juggle priorities and focus your time on the things that add the most value.

The Senior Leaders are appreciative, hardworking and will value the contribution you bring to making their lives easier. We’re growing fast, and you’ll be an integral part of our journey, with the chance to push the boundaries of what’s possible and make a difference to a lot of people.

What you’ll be doing 

- Acting as the point of contact between our Senior Leaders and internal/external clients, distributing correspondence in an efficient and mindful manner.

- Creating, drafting and formatting communications for diverse audiences and formats, such as PowerPoint presentations and reports.

- Planning and coordinating off-sites, meetings and small team events for Senior Leaders and their teams.

- Planning, coordinating and running annual Board offsite meetings.

- Attending meetings, taking minutes, delegating actions and managing progress.

- Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and booking travel.

- Handling the inevitable last-minute juggling that comes with supporting a team of busy, dedicated senior people.

Requirements 

What you’ll bring.

- Organized and proactive: you juggle multiple projects at once without dropping any balls, take responsibility and create opportunity.

- Always one step ahead: you embrace change, instinctively know what needs to get done, then make it happen.

- Excellent communication: you write and speak well for diverse audiences, and you’re creative and detail-focused in getting the message across.

- Teamwork, one of our core values: you’re a people person who builds strong relationships with colleagues, investors, the board and clients.

- Customer-focused: you thrive on delivering a great service and making life easier for those you support.

- Resilient, tenacious and a pleasure to work with, making Q fun wherever you are.

Our mission. 

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you. 

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q . We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist. 

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

description:
LA MAISON 

Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. 

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. 

VOTRE RÔLE 

En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. 

Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits. 

VOS MISSIONS 

· Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente. 

· Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. 

· Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients. 

· Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires. 

· Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées. 

· Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe. 

· Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV. 

· Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines. 

· Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence. 

PROFIL 

· Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe. 

· Première expérience en vente ou relation client appréciée. 

· Excellentes capacités de communication et sens du service client. 

· Enthousiaste, curieux(se) et doté(e) d’un esprit d’initiative. 

· Adaptable et proactif(ve), avec un fort esprit d’équipe. 

· Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, une troisième langue serait un plus.
