Nous recherchons un Machine Learning Engineer pour rejoindre nos équipes et intervenir au cœur de la stratégie Data de nos clients (Industrie, Finance, Énergie). Votre objectif principal sera d'industrialiser les algorithmes de Machine Learning et de garantir leur cycle de vie en production. 

Vous interviendrez sur trois axes techniques majeurs : 

1. Industrialisation & Déploiement (Model Serving) 

- Transformation des modèles de recherche (Proof of Concept) en code de production robuste, testé et optimisé. 

- Développement d'APIs performantes (FastAPI, Flask) pour exposer les modèles aux applications métiers. 

- Conteneurisation des solutions (Docker) et orchestration sur des clusters (Kubernetes) pour assurer la scalabilité et la haute disponibilité. 

2. Architecture MLOps & Automatisation 

- Conception et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD dédiés au Machine Learning (réentraînement automatique, validation des modèles). 

- Mise en place et gestion d'outils d'orchestration de flux de données (Airflow, Kubeflow, Dagster). 

- Gestion du versioning des données et des modèles (DVC, MLflow) pour assurer la reproductibilité des expériences. 

3. Performance & Optimisation 

- Optimisation des temps de réponse (latence) et de l'utilisation des ressources de calcul (CPU/GPU). 

- Refactoring de code pour respecter les standards de Software Craftsmanship (Clean Code, TDD). 

- Gestion des Feature Stores pour centraliser et servir les variables calculées en temps réel. 

Votre rôle inclura également : 

Monitoring avancé : Mise en place de sondes pour détecter le "Data Drift" (dérive des données) ou le "Model Drift" et déclencher des alertes proactives. 

Collaboration transverse : Faire le pont entre les Data Scientists (mathématiques/modélisation) et les Data Engineers (infrastructure/données) pour fluidifier les mises en production. 

Évangélisation : Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel au sein des équipes Data Science. 

Profil recherché 

Nous cherchons un profil hybride, à la frontière entre le Software Engineering et la Data Science, capable de comprendre les mathématiques sous-jacentes tout en maîtrisant les contraintes de production informatique.

- Compétences Techniques Cœurs : 

* Maîtrise avancée de Python et des bonnes pratiques logicielles (Git, Tests unitaires/d'intégration, Packaging). 

* Solide expérience sur les plateformes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et l'IaC (Terraform est un plus). 

* Maîtrise de l'écosystème MLOps : MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes. 

- Connaissances Data : Bonne compréhension des bibliothèques ML (Scikit-learn, Pandas) et Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch) pour pouvoir optimiser le code des Data Scientists. 

- Expérience : Vous avez une expérience significative dans le déploiement de modèles ML en production (batch ou temps réel). 

- Mindset : 

* Rigueur absolue sur la qualité du code et l'automatisation. 

* Goût pour la résolution de problèmes d'architecture complexes. 

* Capacité à travailler dans des environnements techniques hétérogènes.

Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. 

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 

Ton équipe : 

Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. 

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. 

Tes futures missions : 

En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo , ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. 

Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. 

Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo : 

- Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur , en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement. 

- Produire du code de qualité dans les délais , en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée. 

- Mener des investigations techniques , débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement. 

- Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes 

- Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements 

Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : 

- iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning.

- Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires . Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle , impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. 

Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python… 

Tes perspectives d'évolution : 

Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras : 

- Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité 

- Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique 

- Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…) 

- Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc 

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : 

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits . 

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. 

Profil recherché : 

Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler . 

- Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur 

- Tu as entre 0 et 2 ans d'expérience 

- Tu aimes travailler en équipe et intéragir avec des profils et des métiers variés, en faisant preuve de pédagogie et d’esprit constructif (revues de code, pair programming) 

- Tu es orienté·e création de valeur : tu t’intéresses à l’activité du client et tu ne fais pas de la tech pour la tech 

- Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI , et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique 

- Tu fais preuve d’ exigence sur la qualité du travail produit et sais questionner, voire interrompre, la chaîne de production lorsque nécessaire (#jidoka) 

- Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée et appliques naturellement des principes d’organisation et d’amélioration continue (inspirés du 5S ) 

- Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiative 

Le processus de recrutement : 

- Un premier call de 30 minutes avec un recruteur 

- Un échange d’une heure avec le même recruteur 

- Un exercice de refactoring à effectuer chez toi, suivi d’un échange avec un tech lead pour revenir sur tes erreurs 

- Un exercice en direct de debuging 

- Un entretien dirigeant de 30 minutes pour revenir sur tes motivations à rejoindre Theodo et répondre à tes derniers questions 

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 

L’environnement: 

💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 

🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne . Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 

🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 

🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel 

Le package : 

📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 

💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’ intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 

🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 

🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 

🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 

🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 

🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 

🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées 

Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About Rivia 

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

About AI Engineering at Rivia 

Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform.

The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​

By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence.

The Role 

As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​

You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​

The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain.

What excites you 

- Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team.

- Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials.

- Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential.

- Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape.

Responsibilities 

- Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases.

- Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value.

- Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor.

- Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production.

- Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials.

- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to ensure AI features are usable, trusted, and commercially impactful.

- Stay deeply current with the LLM ecosystem, actively experiment with new models and tools, and translate innovation into practical product advantage.

What Excites us 

- Product mindset, with a demonstrated ability to translate user workflows into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production

- Deep familiarity with the current LLM ecosystem and active experimentation with new models, tools, and techniques.

- Proven experience building and shipping production-grade AI or agentic systems, ideally in high-stakes or complex domains.

- Strong software engineering skills and comfort owning systems end-to-end, from design to deployment and maintenance.

- Experience going from 0→1 at a VC-backed startup or similarly fast-paced environment.

Hiring Process 

Our hiring process takes 2-5 weeks over four distinct stages:

- Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

- Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

- Coding Interview: 60 mins with the team to assess your coding skills.

- Meet the team: 3-4 hours. Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit.

Our Values 

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

- In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

- Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

- Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

- Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

- Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

- Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

title: Procurement & Supply Chain Lead
description:
About Hyperscale Power 

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. As we scale from Alpha customer readiness toward Production and Volume Readiness, securing the right components at the right price and lead time – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs and mechanical parts – becomes mission-critical.

The role 

As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale.

This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components.

What you will do 

- Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production.

- Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts.

- Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status and expedite as needed to meet production schedules.

- Source and coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers (EMS, PCB vendors, logistics partners) on order status, lead times and quality issues.

- Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, communicate them clearly to suppliers, and identify alternate sourcing options for critical or long-lead-time components.

- Support supplier qualification and specification compliance for new and existing vendors.

- Maintain purchasing records, the Bill of Materials (BOM) and sourcing data; track lead times, inventory levels and supplier performance, and flag supply chain risks.

- Drive logistics and inbound/outbound shipments together with our logistics partners.

- Scale the supplier base and purchasing processes as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness.

What you bring 

- BSc in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or comparable education, or equivalent experience.

- Several years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing or supply chain, specifically in electronics or hardware manufacturing.

- Strong negotiation skills; track record of managing supplier contracts and pricing.

- Specific experience sourcing electronic or mechanical components (semiconductors, PCBs, magnetics, enclosures); experience with contract manufacturers (EMS) is a plus.

- Organised and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple supplier relationships.

- Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with Engineering and Operations in a fast-paced start-up environment with evolving priorities.

- Fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

What we offer 

- Equity + competitive salary.

- Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

- Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW 

R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty.

In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster?

ROLE OVERVIEW 

You'll lead our EMEA R&D Solution Consulting organisation: a team of 12, with two first-line leaders covering our Enterprise and Strategic segments, plus occasional support for APAC deals. You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Be the scientific voice in the room. Brief the GM and account teams before key meetings, then join them as a peer to the CSOs and Heads of R&D across the table. Act as senior sponsor on our largest EMEA opportunities, and use account-team introductions to open new R&D relationships.

- Lead the 10x conversation. Turn Benchling's vision, from AI agents to Science Foundries, into a credible plan R&D leaders can act on, including how their scientists move onto Benchling and what changes in the lab.

- Lead and develop two first-line leaders and their team of 10. Provide in-region leadership continuity, set the scientific bar for every customer engagement, and build a succession plan as the team grows.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. 

How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?

At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.

Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. 

To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.

Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility 

Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?

During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.

Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.

How you will make a difference 

- Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.

- Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.

- Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.

- Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.

- Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.

- Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.

- Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.

- Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.

What you bring 

- An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject.

- Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative.

- An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply.

- Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. 

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. 

- An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.

- Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. 

Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.

What you can expect 

High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. 
We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.

A view of the whole business. 
You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.

Direct access and room to take initiative. 
Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.

The opportunity to build a future with us. 
If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company.

You will also benefit from:

- Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. 

- A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars.

- A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together!

Ready to make a difference? 

Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? 

We look forward to meeting you.

Experience

description:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. About the role: 

Your responsibilities as a Director, EMEA Ocean Operations include, but are not limited to the following:

- Lead and develop a leadership team of Senior Managers and Managers, who in turn run Ocean Operations teams across EMEA. You are accountable for organisation design, hiring plans and succession planning at every level beneath you. You build a culture of high performance and psychological safety, and you make sure the organisation scales with the business rather than just adding people.

- Own end-to-end EMEA ocean gateway operations (FCL and LCL) across all markets, both insourced and partner-operated countries. You set one operating standard for how work is done, and you decide where it makes sense for local markets to differ.

- Define and deliver the multi-year EMEA ocean strategy and the planning cycles that support it (biannual planning and quarterly check-ins). You separate what the core operation needs to keep running well from what is expansion, and you turn that into clear choices on investment, team size and priorities, aligned with EMEA operations goals.

- Build and drive the EMEA ocean automation roadmap with your teams. You decide where to remove manual work first, so that volume growth does not need proportional growth in manual work, and you work with Product, Engineering and Operational Excellence to deliver it.

- Act as the senior operations voice to EMEA Operational Excellence, Global Product and Engineering. You turn operational pain points across EMEA into clear product priorities, and you help decide what gets built.

- Report to the EMEA Head of Operations and serve as a member of the EMEA Senior Leadership Team. You help set the direction for EMEA as a whole, not just for your own area.

- Partner with EMEA commercial leadership (GMs) and global operations leaders in other regions. You make sure commercial promises and operational reality match, you flag deal and delivery risk early, and you share what works across regions.

- Hold executive-level relationships with key clients, carriers and partner operators. You lead major escalations, negotiate service commitments with partners, and represent EMEA operations in client business reviews.

- Use data to find the biggest bottlenecks and root causes across markets, not just fix individual cases. You set the metrics the organisation runs on and make sure leaders at every level are held to them in regular reviews (weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews).

- Own the long-term capacity plan. You work with Operations Excellence and Finance on staffing models that cope with seasonal peaks and multi-year growth, including the balance between insourced teams and partners.

- Own the P&L and operational health of EMEA ocean gateway operations. You set the financial discipline for your area, stop revenue and cost leakage at scale (for example, billing accessorials), and make sure your leaders do the same in their teams.

Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research

About Panteia 

Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence.

This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.

The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners.

Key responsibilities 

Project delivery & leadership 

- Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research.

- Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination.

- Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners.

Team & quality leadership 

- Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners).

- Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes.

Role in acquisition & transition

- Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution.

Position in the organisation

Practicalities

title: Embedded Staff Engineer
description:
Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on.  

About Priva   

Your Future Ecosystem   

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

 

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

 

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.   
 

Why this role matters 

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability.

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance.

This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer 

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices.

You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team 

You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do 

- Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux 

- Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components 

- Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies 

- Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments 

- Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks 

- Contribute to software architecture and design decisions 

- Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates 

- Support application lifecycle management (ALM) 

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) 

What you bring 

- 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) 

- Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) 

- Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles 

- Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization 

- Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems 

- Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial 

- Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) 

- Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions 

- Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills 

- Experience working in cross-functional and international teams 

Nice to have 

- Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems 

- Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems 

- Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments 

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 

- Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

 

What you get   
In numbers  

- A competitive salary based on your experience; 

- We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

- 8% holiday allowance; 

- Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability  

- Be secured with our pension plan; 

- Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

- Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

- Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values 
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 

Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. 

We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves. 

Apply 
Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? Apply below or contact us for more information. We’ll get back to you within two weeks, we are keen to get to know you!

title: Security Architect
description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products. 

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

- Physical/embedded device security. 

- OT (operational technology) network security. 

- OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

- Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines. 

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

- Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

- Security architecture review process 

- Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

- Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

- Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

- Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

- Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

- Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work. 

To succeed in this role: 

- You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

- You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security " 

- You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

- You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

- You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

- You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

- You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

- You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

- You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

- Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

- You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

- ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

- Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

- Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

- Zero trust architecture principles 

- Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  

The following competence is desired: 

- OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP)

- Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it.

- Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.

- Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.

- Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.

- Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform.

What you’ll do

- Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against.

- Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it.

- Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language.

- Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it.

- Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform.

- Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment.

What you’ll bring

- Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production.

- A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried.

- Experience designing distributed systems designed to run on Kubernetes first.

- The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific.

- You prototype to learn, and you ship.

- The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning.

- Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.

- Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.

This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We aren't looking for depth in a particular testing framework. We're looking for someone who has built with agents, experienced the validation gap firsthand, and wants to solve it.

About the team 

The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform
description:
We are looking for a product-minded AI engineer to turn what our customers are trying to decide into agents they actually rely on. AskWaive, our in-product assistant, is already live; the work now is quality, coverage, and an experience that wows.

This is not a role for a prompt author or a demo builder. We want an owner: someone who takes a customer need—already expressed through our serving layers and semantic layer—and turns it into an endpoint, a tool, and an experience that makes the customer measurably better at their job. Agent engineering, deployment, and testing are all part of delivery, not a handoff.

Our core data platform is owned by the team that built it. You'll build on top of it—and where data or infrastructure is holding an agent back, you'll have the standing to propose the change and drive it.

What You'll Do

From Customer Need to Product Superpower 

- 
Own the Outcome: Start from the customer, and stay with it until the agent is answering their needs better 

- 
Build Agents and Tools: Build production agents and the tools they call—retrieval, multi-step workflows, action-taking—on Amazon Bedrock, with Bedrock AgentCore as our runtime and tools exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol).

- 
Turn Serving Layers Into Capability: Our semantic layer and service APIs are where customer needs are already expressed. Your job is turning them into endpoints and tools an agent can wield well—and knowing which metrics and entities it should reach at all.

- 
Shape the Experience, Not Just the Endpoint: How an answer arrives—its speed, its confidence, its explanation, the next step it offers—is the product. A technically correct response a customer ignores is a failure.

Prove It and Make It Felt 

- 
Measure Groundedness: Build the eval harness—labeled test sets, groundedness and hallucination rates you can put a number on, and CI gates that stop a regression before it ships. 

- 
Measure What Customers Got: Adoption, feedback, intent—then report realized impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up. 

- 
Diagnose and Iterate: Instrument the tracing that shows why an answer was wrong, turn each failure mode into a specific fix, and ship again. This loop is the job, not a phase of it.

Deliver 

- 
Ship and Operate: Own the serving path—MCP endpoints, latency, cost per response, caching, and runtime guardrails. Deployment and testing are part of the job, not a handoff.

- 
Embed and Influence: Partner with Product Managers and engineers on which decisions an agent should support—and which it shouldn't. Where data or infrastructure limits what an agent can do, drive the change alongside the team that owns the platform.

Who You Are

The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions with the agent's help, not by whether it shipped.

The Agent Builder: You've taken an agent past the demo. You know the hard part is everything after it works once—coverage, grounding, cost, and the failure modes you only see at scale. You fix problems without waiting for a ticket.

The Experience Obsessive: You care how an answer lands, not just whether it was right. Trustworthy, fast, and legible beats clever.

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you are a builder who cares about the "why" behind the code, we want to hear from you!

HOW WE WORK 

We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next task faster for the whole team. The leverage is in the verification: the tests, CI gates, and typed interfaces that make agent-written code safe to merge.

What You"ll Bring

- 
Experience: 5+ years building production software or data-intensive systems used by real customers, with strong Python skills—including at least one LLM or agent feature you shipped to production users.

- 
AWS & Agent Stack: Hands-on AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Equivalent agent runtimes transfer, but we build on AWS and you'll be productive faster if you have prior exposure.

- 
Agent Engineering: Orchestration, tool and function design, context assembly, and multi-step workflows—you've made the design calls, not just the prompt calls.

- 
Retrieval & Domain Grounding: You've built retrieval over real business data, you can explain how context gets selected and why an answer was wrong, and you have enough SQL and metric fluency to catch an agent answering with the wrong number.

- 
Evaluation & Iteration: You've built or owned an eval loop for a generative system—labelled sets, regression gates, and a number you could defend when someone asked whether it got better.

- 
Product Sense for AI: You have opinions about how an agent should behave—when to answer, when to ask, when to refuse, how to show its work—and you've shipped those opinions, not just argued them.

- 
Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified what an agent actually delivered for users—adoption, task success, decision quality—and presented it to people who were never going to read your traces.

- 
Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real production work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the harnesses that make the next task faster.

- 
Communication & Collaboratio n: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working across technical and non-technical teams.

Bonus Points For: 

- 
LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith, or Arize).

- 
Semantic layer or metrics-layer design (Ossie, dbt).

- 
Field-service, logistics, or other operational SaaS domains.

- 
Prior experience as a senior or lead engineer responsible for guiding technical direction.

Location: Remote (UK-based) with occasional collaborative team meetups.

Right to Work: Applicants must currently have the legal right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

Compensation

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US 

- 
Laid back but focused: We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment and a passion for developing innovative, best-in-class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers.

- 
Impact-driven: We care deeply and deliver services and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses.

- 
Trust & Inclusion: We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust and mutual respect.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED 

- 
Competitive company pension scheme with employer match.

- 
Generous holiday allowance / flexible time off plus UK bank holidays.

- 
Enhanced maternity, paternity, and parental leave policies.

- 
Ongoing learning resources.

- 
Comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) providing free 24/7 mental health, legal, and financial guidance.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees in accordance with the Equality Act 2010. 

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies show that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. If you feel you could make a great impact in this role, we encourage you to apply anyway!

title: Golang System Software Engineer - Containers / Virtualisation
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

The mission of the LXD team is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We are hiring a Golang software engineer to work on the low level Go codebase sitting between our REST API and the low level C libraries used to manage containers and virtual machines. We are looking for system-level developers with experience in design and data management/modeling.

LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.

What you will focus on

- Design, implement and document system level Go code

- Model data, design database schema and implement data storage in a dqlite (SQL) database

- Maintain code quality through static analysis, unit and system tests

- Collaborate proactively with a distributed team

- Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions

- Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks/year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

- You have experience programming in Go and C

- You are knowledgeable in networking and storage technologies

- You have experience with two or more of: cloud computing, virtualisation, containers, distributed systems, open source community

- You are curious, flexible, articulate and accountable

- You value soft skills and are enterprising, thoughtful and self-motivated

- You have a bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

- Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

- Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Experimentation
description:
About the Job: 

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Experimentation team.

The Experimentation team is building one of the company’s most strategic product areas: a platform that helps leading engineering organizations move beyond intuition and make product decisions with real statistical confidence.

Sitting at the intersection of large-scale systems, data science, and user experience, the team is creating a best-in-class experimentation product that lets customers set up, manage, and analyze experiments with ease while still earning the trust of even the most rigorous data teams.

From warehouse-native analysis to experimentation workflows built on top of LaunchDarkly’s massive feature management scale, this team is tackling ambitious technical problems with visible customer impact and a clear opportunity to define the future of modern software experimentation.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design and operate the services that power this product, contribute to technical direction, and help deliver new functionality to customers.

You will work closely with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers across LaunchDarkly to solve complex, data-intensive problems with meaningful customer impact.

Responsibilities:

- Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs that power LaunchDarkly’s Experimentation product.

- Own backend components across their lifecycle, including technical discovery, design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement.

- Build and evolve systems supporting experiment setup, event data ingestion, metric computation, results processing, and results presentation.

- Contribute to architectural decisions and technical proposals, making thoughtful trade-offs around scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability.

- Partner with product managers, designers, data scientists, and adjacent engineering teams to translate customer needs and product goals into reliable technical solutions.

- Collaborate with Data Platform, Warehouse Integrations, SDK, and other teams on shared data flows, services, and cross-team dependencies.

- Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes.

- Improve observability, testing, deployment safety, operational processes, and the reliability of the systems you build.

- Participate in the team’s on-call rotation and take ownership of production systems in a you-build-it-you-run-it culture.

- Support teammates through thoughtful code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and informal mentorship.

Qualifications:

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building and operating backend services in production.

- Fluency using AI tools in software engineering workflows, including the judgment to direct, evaluate, and validate AI-generated output.

- Experience designing and delivering customer-facing systems that are scalable, reliable, observable, and maintainable.

- Strong programming experience in Go or a comparable backend language such as Python, Rust, or C++. Our team is using Go.

- Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, APIs, data modeling, or data-intensive services.

- Familiarity with analytical, operational, or warehouse data stores such as ClickHouse, Postgres, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.

- Experience diagnosing production issues and improving system reliability through metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and other observability practices.

- Experience working in a cloud environment and with infrastructure-as-code or equivalent deployment and operations tooling.

- Ability to take an ambiguous problem from discovery and scoping through design, implementation, launch, and ongoing operation.

- Clear, thoughtful communication and a collaborative approach to working with technical and non-technical partners.

- Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, analytics, data platforms, or similarly data-intensive products.

Pay: 

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4: 

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $191,800 - $263,670**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $172,600 - $237,270**

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $163,000 - $224,070**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. 
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. 

About LaunchDarkly: 

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:
